games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.description: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with MORE enemies, MORE weapons, and NEW ways to purge!

games.title: Planet Zoo 2
games.description:
Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2 – the sequel to the beloved zoo simulation game. Let your creativity soar by constructing and managing distinctive zoos around the world, full of awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species for the first time. Plus, take the next step in animal conservation and release your species into customisable, expansive Wildlife Reserves. 

AWE-INSPIRING ANIMALS 
Discover a diverse roster of animal species, each with their own needs & behaviours. New faces join familiar favourites like the African Lion and Western Chimpanzee to create iconic zoo rosters in jaw-dropping detail. 

Construct beautiful habitats for your animals to thrive in as they interact with the world around them in authentic ways. From authentic herding behaviours to grazing on the vegetation you provide for them. Experience a generational leap of animal detail and immersion with incredible natural movements and expressive emotions that bring each animal to life like never before. 

AWESOME AQUATICS 
Prepare your diving suit! Fully aquatic species make a splash in their stunning debut! Build custom spectacular freshwater or saltwater aquariums to home an exciting line-up of delightful swimming animals. A new world beneath the water awaits, filled with colourful shoals of fish, Black-tipped Reef Sharks, Hawksbill Turtles and so many more! 

FREQUENT FLYERS 
Soar to great heights with a diverse mix of bright & brilliant fully flying birds including the vibrant Toco Toucan and majestic Secretary Bird. House your birds in fully customisable aviaries built from barriers, support poles and dynamic mesh covers, allowing them to fly freely and safely. Observe their dynamic behaviours on the ground and in the sky as they glide around unique habitats. 

WILDLIFE RESERVES 
Conservation goes beyond your zoo! Take on global conservation projects and meet specific requirements to release your animals into fully customisable, expansive Wildlife Reserves across the globe in living ecosystems created by you.  

LET YOUR CREATIVITY SOAR 
Build the zoo of your dreams across multiple globe-spanning biomes, with four brand-new scenery themes covering iconic architecture from around the world and five returning themes from the original Planet Zoo, providing you with an expansive library of scenery items to build/create with. 

Effortlessly design your zoos using a range of ready-to-place blueprints or get creative with the Planet franchise’s iconic piece-by-piece construction tools to bring your own ideas to life. 

Delve into every detail with scaling, flexi-colour & easy-to-use pathing systems, together with new foliage and terrain brushes to make grand changes to your zoos and Wildlife Reserves. 

MEANINGFUL MANAGEMENT 
Construct perfect habitats for appealing animals to bring in guests, boosting your zoo’s rating and earning money to fund further expansion. 

Manage day-to-day zoo life as you create immersive spaces for your guests packed with educational opportunities around every corner. Cater to their requirements with a variety of shops and amenities to curate the perfect day out. 

A WILDER WORLD AWAITS 
Join FEN (Fauna and Ecosystems Network) in a fun-filled adventure around the world in Career mode. Build a global network of zoos and Wildlife Reserves and trade animals with other players in Franchise mode or enjoy unlimited creativity in Sandbox mode. 

CONNECTED COMMUNITY 
Discover a world of community content in the Frontier Workshop. Freely explore and download player-created blueprints and creations from across platforms and subscribe to your favourites to place them in your zoos.

games.title: Total War: SHOGUN 2 Complete Edition
games.description:
Experience the updated, enhanced, and complete version of the grand strategy classic; Total War: SHOGUN 2 and all of its DLC, including the Rise of the Samurai and Fall of the Samurai campaigns.

Wage total war, unite Japan and become Shogun. Master Bushido and Chi, war and peace, build alliances, lead massive armies, construct mighty castles and execute acts of cunning subterfuge to fuel your campaigns across the entire Shogun era from the rise of the first Shogun to the fall of the last Samurai.

Command massed armies of samurai warriors in dramatic real-time tactical battles. Master the tactics of the Shogun era and sweep across the battlefields of Feudal Japan, commanding massive, pitched battles, besieging towering fortresses, and springing devastating ambushes. Glorious victory or shameful defeat will be yours.

games.title: Valor Mortis
games.description:
You served Napoleon. You died for Napoleon. You have risen for Napoleon.

You are William, a soldier of the Grande Armée brought back from a battlefield grave. But the Europe you awaken to is not the one you sacrificed for. A mysterious plague now sweeps the continent, and you have been reborn with its corrupting power pulsing through your veins.

Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

games.title: Allogloom
games.description: Join Nora in this mysterious and macabre point and click adventure game. Find and collect items to solve puzzles. Talk to peculiar people and monsters alike. Explore Gruesome Grove and beyond to uncover forgotten truths and save the people of her town!

games.title: Truckful
games.description:
Truckful is a single player car delivery adventure game based around completing errands and quests for villagers and uncovering the ancient mystery that surrounds the nearby old forest.

Drive your pickup truck through winding countryside roads, dusty lowlands and small towns. Upgrade the truck, improve its weight and load capacity to make it go faster through all kinds of demanding routes. Pack the bed with fragile & shaky cargo of all shapes and kinds, whether its ice cold fish that needs to be delivered fast, or a classic grandma vase that will put your driving skills to the true test.

The ancient forest on the countryside outskirts is unwelcoming to visitors and often mentioned in local legends and myths. The overwhelming feeling of something lurking in the tree branch shadows is hard to shake off. Face the adversity and uncover its deep roots.

games.title: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen
games.description:
Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen enriches the dynamic fantasy world and expansive adventures of Dragon's Dogma 2 with unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters.
    Based on feedback we received after the initial release of Dragon's Dogma 2, we established three goals for ourselves when we set out to update and expand the game:
    Enhanced gameplay. Expanded adventures. Enticing value.

games.title: Kingdom Hearts Collection I ~ III
games.description: A value‑packed bundle featuring three collections: KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-, KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue, and KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC).

games.title: Echo Weaver
games.description:
Echo Weaver is a time loop metroidBRAINia where time is your best resource and secrets are your only upgrades. 

You're the last of the Weavers, a remnant of a ruined society trapped in a glitching time loop. The Congregation set out to explore the stars and find paradise. What they found instead has led their utopian project to ash and cinders.

Can you master time itself to unravel the conspiracy at the heart of Provenance?

games.title: Neon Abyss 2
games.description:
Dive deeper into the chaotic, beautifully pixelated Abyss with Neon Abyss 2! The action is faster, the stakes are higher, and the possibilities are endless in this cybermyth roguelike.

With explosive run 'n' gun gameplay, diverse combat styles, and unlimited item synergies, Neon Abyss 2 delivers a dramatic, thrill-packed experience every time you enter.

games.title: Order of the Sinking Star
games.description:
From legendary director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness) comes Order of the Sinking Star, a massive narrative adventure featuring more than one thousand hand-crafted puzzles designed to put your intellect to the test. 

As Queen Effia, you are transported to a realm of curious magic, dangerous contraptions, and vicious monsters. As you make your way, you will explore four distinct worlds, each with its own mechanics, characters, and stories, and then watch as they all collide.

As the worlds merge, and characters meet one another, puzzle systems intertwine, creating surprising new gameplay possibilities. Explore at your own pace, revisit worlds and return to challenges as you see fit. Discover unique playable characters, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher the deep mysteries of a sprawling, interconnected game world. 

Blending exploration, storytelling, and ever-progressing mechanics, Order of the Sinking Star invites you into a mysterious, living puzzle unlike anything you've played.

games.title: Silver Pines
games.description:
Private investigator Red Walker finds himself in Silver Pines, a place half-abandoned, half-forgotten, in the middle of nowhere on a job to track down Eddie Velvet. A musician who has vanished. As the case begins to reveal a dark past, Walker soon slips into a strange and nightmarish descent beyond his control.

Silver Pines is a survival horror metroidvania set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.title: Forever Ago
games.description:
Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption. In this single-player road trip adventure, you'll travel to beautiful places, capture memories with your camera, meet interesting characters, and even make some new friends.

Experience a nuanced and heartfelt story about broken dreams, loss, and regret - but also courage, hope, and true friendship. Learn about the stories, beliefs and struggles of characters you meet along the way, brought to life by renowned voice actors.

Explore beautiful environments, ranging from serene forest trails to dusty barrens sweltering in the desert sun. Examine and interact with objects to learn about your surroundings and the people living there. 

Play through a lifetime of love as Alfred with your sweetheart Audrey, experiencing a true love that transcends time.

games.title: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
games.description:
Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level.

Play the story of Aidan, who must use the power of a mysterious puzzle box – the Genesis Configuration – to help his girlfriend Sunny's escape from the otherworldly hellscape of the Labyrinth.

Wield the powers of the box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead and do battle with the horrific cult devoted to the Cenobites.

A New Story in Hellraiser's Canon – Unwittingly kickstart Pinhead’s ritual to unleash greater pain and pleasure than ever before.

Harness the Power of the Box – Combine the unique, hellish abilities of the Configuration with an arsenal of earthly weapons to inflict bone-breaking, flesh-searing pain - or is it pleasure? - upon masochistic enemies.

Fight Against Unholy Enemies – Take on hell's wretches, deviants, cultists, and even its most infernal priests in a story-driven horror survival game.

games.title: Gears of War: E-Day
games.description:
Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​ 

Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​

Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

games.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
games.description:
Star Wars: Galactic Racer is a runs-based, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim of the Star Wars galaxy.  

The Empire’s grip on the galaxy has finally broken, and with its fall comes a new obsession: speed. As the New Republic struggles to rebuild, gambling, entertainment, and glory fuel a booming underground.  

Out of this chaos, The Galactic League is born: an unsanctioned racing circuit where syndicates sponsor pilots, fortunes are won and lost in seconds, and only the bold survive. 

No Force. No prophecy. Just skill, strategy, and the will to rise.

games.title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
games.description:
Step into the cockpit and take flight as an elite pilot across stunning skies. Enter intense dogfights, eliminate threats, and rise through gripping missions to earn your wings.

Campaign Mode showcases stunning visuals with dynamic multi-layered cloudscapes that capture the majesty of living skies. Feel the rush of a fast-paced arcade-style gameplay and deploy powerful weapons to dominate the battlefield.

Beyond the chaos in the air, breathtaking first-person scenes reveal your pilot’s story through breathtaking cinematics. Experience the pressure of command, the weight of decisions, and the bonds forged in battle. Between missions, bond with your squad members, rise to meet adversity, and prove yourself as a true ace.

games.title: Retrospace
games.description: Immersive, disco-punk, space horror where you can be a sneaky chap or a mutant action hero as you try to survive on a space station swallowed by a black hole. A mind-bending ride with weird creatures, immersive features, time jumps, and '70s mustaches!

games.title: Dynasty Warriors 3 Complete Edition Remastered
games.description: Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered is a striking modern revival of Dynasty Warriors 3 and Dynasty Warriors 3: Xtreme Legends, which established the foundation of the entire series for decades to come. Dynasty Warriors 3 was the first game in the Dynasty Warriors series to feature mechanics that would become a mainstay for the series, such as True Musou Attacks, two-player simultaneous play, and the officer development system. It was also the first game in the series to sell more than one million copies. While reproducing the movements of the original game, the action system of Dynasty Warriors 3 has evolved to be more brilliant and exhilarating. In Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered, players can experience 1 vs. 1,000 action woven by tradition and evolution. In addition, the complete cast of more than 40 officers and numerous battlefields originally featured in the game will be beautifully recreated using Unreal Engine 5, offering peak action and tactical warfare in this thrilling revival. The Dynasty Warriors 3: Xtreme Legends expansion, which is also included, features additional stories for seven officers, including Lu Bu, Meng Huo, and Yuan Shao, as well as bodyguard customization, new weapons, and four types of challenge modes, providing even more gameplay to enjoy in this newly remastered classic. [Koei Tecmo]

games.title: NIPH
games.description: NIPH is a stylish roguelite platformer with risky and intense combat. Slash, shoot, and learn and cast spells with more varied items as you explore a vast and diverse fantasy world!

games.title: Remote Reaper: FPV Drone
games.description: FPV drone simulator. Destroy enemy vehicles with high-precision strikes. Simulation of electronic warfare and realistic armor model.

games.title: Kyofu Yawa: Second Night
games.description: On a rainy night, three ghost stories are told in an old-fashioned café. As a writer for an occult magazine, you listen to three people recount their experiences. A psychological horror visual novel that slowly builds a sense of dread—Kyofu Yawa: Second Night.

games.title: Unrivaled Heroes: 2.5D Brawler
games.description:
Unrivaled Heroes: 2.5D Brawler is 2.5D side-scrolling beat-'em-up where players experience the thrill of multiple unrivaled heroes, each with unique abilities. Master martial arts, unleash powerful skills, and conquer epic bosses. With local co-op for up to 4 players, team up for intense combat and a truly unforgettable adventure.

Set in medieval Indonesia, this game transports players to an era where powerful kingdoms ruled over vast archipelagos. Inspired by Indonesian folklore and mythology, legendary tales come to life through epic battles, brought together with stunning visuals that blend 2D and 3D elements.

Every chapter unfolds a new story, introducing fresh challenges, characters, and environments to explore. As the journey progresses, uncover deeper lore and unexpected twists that shape the world around you.

games.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Avatar Legends
games.description:
The pack includes the following content:

    Aang and Katara as playable characters
    Gliding Air vehicle
    Lion Turtle Island course

games.title: Rockfall
games.description:
Rockfall is a 2D mining game where every descent underground is a risk - and every treasure has a price.

Dig through shifting tunnels, mine valuable ores, gather resources, and upgrade your gear as you venture deeper into a dangerous underground world.

Armed with your pickaxe, a glowing companion, and pure determination, you explore ancient caverns, unstable tunnels, and forgotten dungeons filled with mystery.

But the deeper you go, the more dangerous it becomes. Collapsing traps, unstable terrain, and hidden secrets lie beneath the surface - and staying underground too long may awaken dangers you’re not ready to face.

games.title: Gallery Organizer
games.description: A cozy organizing simulator where you hang up to 1,000 paintings in a messy art gallery. Find and earn helpful tools. Unwind in procedurally generated galleries showcasing real artists.

games.title: Sutja
games.description: A surreal poker roguelite. Stack power cards, attach stickers, reshape your deck, and push Chips × Mult to absurd heights. Face strange bosses, then follow the Journey into questions about choice, art, and what it means to play.

games.title: Wok King
games.description: You and your friends run a Chinese restaurant in a cherry blossom town on an island. You travel to various places to purchase different quality ingredients, frantically completing orders in the kitchen, riding an e-bike to deliver the delicacies to customers, striving to become the wok king!

games.title: A Bad Dream: Trypophobia
games.description: Bad Ninja HD comes with typical jumping gameplay but wit lot more to face on the way!Bad Ninja HD is a skill game, in which the goal is to get the highest floor of the castle. Fight or avoid other ninjas on the way or choose Death. Collect items to help you climb as high as possible. And above all enjoy it.Just tap to change the wall, grab the power ups on the way, use them at you're advantage. Amazing graphics, various funny characters and great music will help you more to enjoy this game.

games.title: Ball Bugz
games.description: Ball Bugs is an incremental defense game where you start with a single persistent ball and build up an arsenal of ball firing turrets, artillery and special ball types. Bounce, splat, upgrade and come back stronger until the bugs stop getting through.

games.title: Ferrite Runner
games.description: Ferrite Runner is a mouse-only cyberpunk extraction RPG with active-time combat. Fight waves and bosses, manage energy and thirst, and escape with your loot. Upgrade your gear and outposts between runs. Trade sealed crates or open them for equipment, then risk your loadout on another run.

games.title: Sinners Please
games.description: Only for sinners. ADMIT or SHOOT. You guard the gate of Hell. Check the papers, X-ray the bags and decide their fate. Some of them are sneaking in from heaven. We only want the sinners! Miss the rent, and Satan collects.

games.title: Bio Inc. Classic
games.description: Cowboy bank-robber in DEEP SPACE! You are Tom the famous space-bank robber. Going from station to station, taking all the new credits you can fit into your digital device, and buying whatever you see in front of you. The Space Cop animals are hot on your trial. Run, jump, and shoot your way to renegade freedom in this futuristic thriller! Killer graphics and game-play and a booming soundtrack make this a sure download for you today!

games.title: Tetherlight
games.description: Tetherlight is a side-scrolling action adventure with a star-fox tether companion. Chain aerial movement and staff combat, confront twisted guardians, and plan your journey through a changing world to break its repeating nights.

games.title: A Deriva
games.description: A fisherman lives on your computer's taskbar. He fishes on his own while you work, from the Araguaia to the sea off Noronha. You glance over now and then, click when one bites, and buy a bigger boat. It also runs as a wallpaper.

games.title: Dealer's Tell: All Bets Are Final
games.description: A roguelite deduction game at a blackjack table. The devil deals - and cheats by a secret rule, a new one every floor. Watch the hands, cross out the suspects and name his scheme before suspicion closes in. Fifteen floors down, new house rules every run. A wrong guess costs your soul.

games.title: JosPlays - Gemhaven
games.description: Match glowing Heartstones to rebuild a forgotten valley. Swap gems, meet each level's goals before you run out of moves, and watch a whole city rise, from a humble hut to the shining Crown Castle, across a 15-level story campaign.

games.title: Rescue the Hostages: Twenty Deadly Questions
games.description: The mad bomber is back with a deadly game of twenty questions. Ask questions, uncover the words, disarm the bomb, and rescue the hostages in this gripping FMV horror experience where every decision could mean the difference between life or death.

games.title: The drawing of the Genesis
games.description: Biker Girls Dream

games.title: Glam Sort
games.description: A cozy, satisfying organizing game where every makeup product has its perfect place. Sort lipsticks, eyeshadows, brushes, perfumes, and more to transform messy shelves into a beautiful, perfectly organized glam shop. Sort, organize, and make it fabulous!

games.title: Sushi Automata
games.description: In this game, you'll run a cat sushi restaurant on the sea, listening music while coding staff to make sushi. Choose visual blocks or a traditional code editor. Optimize code, boost efficiency, earn coins, expand your shop, hire staff, attract customers—enjoy automation and improve your coding.

games.title: Plug and Slay
games.description: Plug and Slay is a short incremental game about outgrowing your machine cage. Purchase anomalous PC parts and traverse a massive skill tree to overwhelm your wardens with automated neon firepower.

games.title: PRINCE OF INDIA
games.description: It's a story of a prince, who crosses many traps and kills all the enemies and recovers a magical gem (which was stolen by the enemy mastermind), to bring his dead father, i.e. the king, back to life with the power of the gem, and also rescues the princess from there.

games.title: Text Dungeon: The Ring of Life
games.description: No graphics, No tiles. Just text-RPG adventure! Explore a shifting labyrinth, regain the Ring of Life from the wizard Shingor. Classic roguelike-style messages guide your journey, with narrative scenes evoking the spirit of MUDs and gamebooks. Death is permanent. Every run brings new discoveries.

games.title: The Witch's Bakery
games.description:
The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris. She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace", a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape. Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the heart.

Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them!

games.title: Hippo Hop
games.description: Hippo Hop is a relaxed 2D flyer where you guide a dapper, winged hippo through fever-dream-50s-jazz-bar-themed handcrafted levels. Flap and glide through the spaces between screen-printing-style instruments, and scoop up glowing drink-themed pickups to the beat of mid-century jazz tracks.

games.title: Love Beyond Differences: Riku & Lily
games.description:
Love Beyond Differences: Riku & Lily is a narrative-driven spot-the-difference puzzle game about love, memory, and the moments that shape a lifetime.

Now elderly, Riku looks through an old photo album with his grandchildren and tells them the story of his life with Lily. Some memories have begun to fade, appearing in grayscale throughout the album. By finding the differences hidden within each illustrated scene, you help Riku reconstruct those memories and restore the pages to full color.

Follow Riku and Lily across 21 chapters, from their younger years through adulthood, family life, and old age. Although they are very different from one another, their story shows how love can grow alongside those differences.

Play at your own pace alone or with someone close to you in local co-op, and revisit completed chapters anytime through Riku’s memory album.

games.title: Thundercade
games.description:
Terrorism has reached new heights. AATOM (Atomic Age Terrorist Organization of Miracali) has constructed its own nuclear power plant, and threatens the world with atomic terror.
The world powers have decided to initiate operation THUNDERCADE to stop AATOM. Equipped with a high-performance combat motorcycle, sidecar cannons, and backed by a precision B-7 bomber, you set out on your dangerous mission. Start in the city streets and continue through bases, woodlands and the fortress before reaching the heavily guarded nuclear power plant.
With a hit-miss ratio display at the end of each stage, you can improve your attack efficiency. Have a friend join in and save the world together! Go for the challenge!!!

games.title: Manga Studio Tycoon
games.description: 最初の一作は、小さなガレージから。あなたのマンガスタジオは、どこまで成長できるでしょうか。ジャンル、テーマ、読者層を組み合わせてオリジナルのマンガを企画し、ストーリー作り、作画、仕上げを進めましょう。読み切り作品を発表することも、ウェブ連載を続けることもできます。次の話に取りかかるタイミングも、物語を完結させるタイミングも、あなた次第です。スタッフを雇って育て、仕事を割り振り、スタジオの成長に合わせて広いオフィスへ。表紙をデザインし、作品を宣伝し、日々の売上から読者の反応を確かめましょう。単行本の印刷、イベントへの参加、ライセンス契約、業界の賞への挑戦も。創作へのこだわりと経営のやりくりを両立させ、年間最優秀マンガ賞を目指しましょう。初めての作品から、活気あふれる大きなスタジオへ。あなたならではの物語を生み出す場所を育ててください。

games.title: Thank You Bus Driver
games.description:
Take on the role of a town’s rules-driven (and reckless) bus driver in Thank You Bus Driver! 

Drive fast, slap faster, and toss any rulebreakers out of your bus to reach true victory: being appreciated.

Run a strict bus and you may very well become the best bus driver this town has ever seen.

games.title: How to Wait for the Bus
games.description: The bus will arrive when it arrives. In the meantime, make some tiles explode. Fire coloured tiles into the board from any edge. Line up three or more matching tiles to make them explode, trigger chain reactions, and gradually clear the board.

games.title: Colors Of V
games.description: A vector dungeon on a monochrome tube, lit by three subtractive colour gels. Drop a gel and half the room stops existing: a wall you cannot see is not solid, an enemy you cannot see is frozen and cannot be shot. The colour channel is the collision layer, so sight and physics never drift.

games.title: SHOCKWAVE TRIGGERS
games.description:
Shockwave Triggers is a vertical scrolling shoot’em up where you’ll choose between 2 pilots – the fast and versatile Amira, whose crystal-sensitive sister has been kidnapped, and the slower but more powerful Turbo B, a mechanic determined to take down the supreme leader of the WW army!

Enjoy anime-style cutscenes and a pumping soundtrack as you blast through 6 unique stages of bullet hell mayhem. Collect crystals from destroyed enemies, initiate shockwaves to cancel incoming projectiles into gems, deploy super attacks and upgrade your ship with character-specific armaments!

Use the shop system to earn new features or buy extra credits, choose from multiple difficulties to suit your playstyle, fill your gallery with unlockable art and use the jukebox feature to enjoy the game’s original soundtrack. Team up for local co-op play, dare to challenge Boss Rush mode and test your skills against online leaderboards!

games.title: ORBITA: Bingo roguelite
games.description: A bingo roguelite where you choose the balls. Set up patterns, combine 57 amulets and send your score soaring through an arcade of strange rules. Clear 12 stops across 4 rooms, overcome their keepers and help Mara recover a lost signal.

games.title: Ghost//Root
games.description: Enter a locked network through one surviving terminal. Read conflicting records, question witnesses, and use recovered programs to uncover why an autonomous machine refused its orders. A retro terminal mystery in four acts, with six endings shaped by your decisions.

games.title: Starjaunt
games.description: You start with a shuttle.Not a warship. Not a legend. A shuttle, a modest hold, and enough fuel to reach somewhere that isn't here.What happens after that is genuinely up to you. Starjaunt is an open galaxy of forty-four star systems, nine factions with their own grudges and their own ships, and a war that keeps moving whether or not you're involved in it. You can spend the whole game hauling grain and never fire a shot. You can spend it taking systems by force. Most people do something in between and find out what that makes them.[hr][/hr]Pick a life, or don'tMerchant. Buy low, sell high, watch prices move as the war strangles supply lines. Trade up from a shuttle to a freighter to a hold that pays for itself.Miner. Work the asteroid belts, sell ore to refineries, stay out of everyone's politics.Bounty hunter. Hunt people who don't want to be found, across a six-part arc that gets more complicated the closer you get.Spy. Thirteen missions of intelligence work — planted evidence, two-stage extractions, freighter interdictions, and bribes that show up in your ledger as negative pay. Nobody stays clean.Combat pilot. Fly for a flag. Take contracts, take systems, take losses.Fleet commander. You don't need a carrier to stop flying alone. Make friends who fly your wing for nothing, hire guns at the bar who fly it for a fee, or earn enough trust from a faction's command that they stop handing you contracts and start handing you berths.Nine factions, and none of them are simply rightThe Federation — order and duty, expressed as slow ships with too much armor and a tariff schedule for everything.The Rebel Alliance — speed as armor, freedom as a grievance, captured tech held together with conviction.The Free Frontier — farmers, ice-miners and free-port harbormasters who want to be left alone and are squeezed by everyone. They fight defensively and they remember who helped.The Helios Combine — a megacorp that owns the mines, the patents and the foundries, sells arms to both sides, and does not want the war to end. Drone swarms, because people are expensive.The Artifact Order — monastic zealots who hold the Precursor ruins sacred and will ram your hull to prove it.The Federation Bastion — the hardliner splinter that thinks the Federation went soft. Siege doctrine, scorched earth, no negotiated peace, ever.Pirates, the Merchant Guild, and the Independent worlds that keep their heads down while everyone else fights.Each faction's mission arc unlocks its own hulls, one ship at a time, behind its own missions — fifty-four ships and forty-three weapon and outfit systems across the roster. Fly Federation long enough and you'll be trusted with a carrier. Fly for the Order and you'll be trusted with something stranger.The war moves without youSystems aren't decorations with a flag painted on. Control is a live number, and player missions push it. Take enough of a frontier system for the Rebels and it turns green on the star map — and then the markets restock from Rebel suppliers, Rebel patrols replace Federation ones, prices shift, standings follow, and the contracts on offer change with them. Contested systems spawn both sides at once and let them fight it out in front of you.Nothing about that is scripted. It falls out of one number per system, and it means the galaxy you're flying through in hour forty is not the one you started in.Nobody out here flies on railsThe pilots you fight weren't handed a patrol route and a state machine. They were trained — a neural network taught to fly by reinforcement learning, in simulation systems built for the purpose, until pirates learned to hunt traders and patrols learned to protect them.What comes out the other side is pilots with personalities. Some are reckless and some won't commit. Some break off a fight they're losing and some absolutely will not. They misjudge, they overextend, and now and then they do something you wouldn't have thought of. You end up reading them the way you'd read a person, because in the only sense that matters at knife-fight range, that's what the training produced.Land, and step outDocking isn't a menu. Set down and you walk the world on foot — desert outposts under prefab domes, forested colonies with lakes and lumber, company towns, garrisons, free ports. Find the fuel depot. Argue with the mechanic. Sell your haul at the warehouse and learn at the bar what's worth carrying next.You don't have to fly aloneThere are three ways to stop, and they cost you different things.Make friends. Twelve companions can be earned across the storylines — a cashiered Federation ace who flies angry, a homesteader who doesn't forget a kindness, a smuggler paying off a debt in escort hours. They fly their own ships, talk to you in combat, walk beside you when you land, and each has their own mission arc.Hire guns. Every bar has a wingman desk. Pay the fee and a veteran, a rookie or a mercenary flies your wing until they die or you let them go. When a hire dies you're out the money. When a friend dies you're out a friend — and there's a ledger for the ones who don't come back.Earn a fleet. Fly long enough for a faction and its command stops offering you contracts and starts offering you berths. Federation carrier certification, signed off by an officer who's watched you work. A converted capital hull the Alliance names you the first captain of. A deck on a Free Fleet carrier, handed over by a pirate king who decides you've earned it. Nobody sells you a fleet. You're given one, by people who had to be convinced.And past the last charted jumpSomething built the ruins at Tau Ceti and seeded the exotic matter at the fringe. It is gone, but not entirely.Out beyond Sanctum, through a jump that isn't stable, the Rift holds something dormant that answers when the relics are disturbed. It doesn't trade. It doesn't bargain. It doesn't hate you. It responds — and when it starts responding, the Federation's quarrel with the Rebels stops looking like the important story.How that ends is the one choice the game really asks you for. Seal it. Wake it. Or take it apart and use it.[hr][/hr]At a glance44 star systems across seven distinct regions — core worlds, contested borderlands, frontier reaches, company space, fortress systems, a monastic road, and a deep nobody comes back from134 missions, including six full faction campaigns that converge on the same battles from opposite sides54 ships and 43 weapons and outfits, most gated behind the factions that build themA live faction war that redraws the map, the markets and the trafficEnemy and civilian pilots flown by a reinforcement-learning policy rather than a scriptOn-foot exploration of every world you land on — deserts, ice fields, gardens, company towns, free ports12 companions to earn, mercenaries to hire, and fleets handed to you by factions that learned to trust you — companions who die stay deadThree endingsWindows, macOS and LinuxKeyboard only at launch.

games.title: Lootkeeper: Tidy Up the Loot
games.description: An adventurer has returned from his journey with 1834 items he'll never use. Now it's your job to sort his loot. Organize weapons, potions, relics, and all kinds of RPG junk, and use magic and upgrades to speed up the work. The loot chaos awaits!

games.title: Le Tapis Vert
games.description: Belote, Solitaire, Backgammon, Yatzy, Sudoku… 24 card and board games gathered on one green table. Play solo against the computer, pass-and-play with friends, or online with a friend. No ads, no microtransactions.

games.title: Food Truck Frenzy
games.description: Jump into the food truck to grill juicy cuts to the perfect temperature, prepare loaded burritos at top speed, and make delicious pizzas with the right dough and toppings. Time every flip, follow each recipe, and complete orders quickly to rack up the highest score!

games.title: Wattverse
games.description: Generate electricity in Wattverse! Build your power production, unlock powerful upgrades, automate your energy empire, and push your numbers to unimaginable scales in this addictive incremental game.

games.title: Sourcebound
games.description: The screen is black. Sound is your only light. Every step and every sonar pulse paints the walls in neon, and every blind hunter hears it. Sneak, sprint and throw pebbles through twenty procedurally generated levels to reach the Source of silence.

games.title: Wickling
games.description: A cheerful 8-bit kingdom platformer with a candle for a head and something wrong underneath. World maps, power-up suits, fortresses and airships in the spirit of the NES classics. And a stalker that only moves when you look away. Don't let your flame go out.

games.title: Hubert
games.description:
Step into the paws of Hubert, a loyal shepherd navigating the uncharted northern wilderness.

In this atmospheric third-person adventure, guide a scattered flock of sheep across gorgeous nature, braving harsh weather, treacherous terrain, and hidden dangers. 

Hubert blends immersive storytelling with a unique herding gameplay experience, all from the perspective of a devoted working dog.

games.title: Smiley Arena
games.description: Defend your turf against endless waves of grinning enemies! Pick from 6 unique smiley classes with their own abilities, build and upgrade turrets across multiple lanes, and take down ever-tougher bosses – a colorful tower-defense hybrid built for replayability.

games.title: Whispers Of The Lost Ticket
games.description: Whispers of the Lost Ticket is an exploration horror game centered around uncovering the events surrounding Guilded Hollow Carnival through story and event interactions while shadowy forces try to stop you. Uncover the secrets of those who came before you, as the carnival welcomes its final visitor

games.title: Gym Bros: LooksMaxx
games.description: Get swol, race to the mirror, and strike ridiculous poses for clout in this multiplayer social VR party game. Compete with friends, customize your bro, and climb the leaderboard. Skip leg day, flex for the feed, and become the ultimate giga-chad. Do it. We believe in you.

games.title: Undead Gunline
games.description: Undead Gunline is a fast-paced, single-player turret shooter. Aim and fire with your mouse to stop zombie waves on a desert highway, then spend earned resources on upgrades to strengthen your rolling gun platform and push farther down the road.

games.title: Pipkind: A Dice Puzzle Adventure
games.description: Pop matching dice, collect playful outfits and help 100 quirky friends in a colorful retro puzzle adventure. Explore a growing village, tackle 1,000 campaign levels, or chase your best score in an ever-faster Marathon. Think fast: wrong shots stack up!

games.title: Nut Runner
games.description: Nut Runner is a colourful 2D platforming adventure! Run, jump and slide through 40 increasingly challenging levels across five unique zones. Collect nuts, dodge obstacles and master each stage as you help our speedy squirrel race all the way to the finish!

games.title: 100s Fishing
games.description: Race against a 100-second clock to catch as many fish as possible in this fast-paced score attack game. Chain same-colored catches for combo bonuses, aim for the 100,000-point goal, and complete your Creature List to earn a special rosette.

games.title: FLYBRAIN LAB
games.description: An experimental simulator about a digitized fruit fly. Press buttons, change conditions and stimuli, observe its reactions, and repeat experiments to uncover the logic behind its behavior. Simple mechanics, strange results, and pure curiosity.

games.title: W DoBark
games.description: A musical match-three with 3D toy puppies. Every match plays a note, every park hides a secret gate to a treasure burrow of rare dogs, and your pup walks a glowing island map from Clover Meadow to the Snowy Pines. No timers, no lives, no ads.

games.title: Embersworn II: Throne of Endless Night
games.description: Forge a deck and confront the Queen of Endless Night in a dark fantasy, turn-based roguelike. Choose the Frostwood Ranger or Runeblade, navigate branching paths, gather relics and potions, and turn every battle into a tactical choice.

games.title: HYPERINFLATION
games.description: A survivors-like about a lone ship facing an endless horde. Shooting is fully automatic - you only decide where to fly. Build your loadout from upgrades, items, and crew, survive duels with elite enemies, and make it far enough to face the bosses.

games.title: Leek Survivors
games.description: Leek Survivors is a market-themed action roguelite. Dodge swarming enemies, gather upgrades, evolve your weapons and turn every risky run into a stronger portfolio. Unlock traders, conquer new arenas and keep fighting when the market refuses to close.

games.title: BIO-SUBMARINER DX
games.description: this means WAR! raise an army of mighty WARRIORS, mystical MAGES, and SAVAGE beasts to FIGHT for YOUR FAITH!??????Long ago, the Four Goddesses joined forces to defeat the Dark Dragon and restore peace to Avalonia. But dark shadows now creep across the land once more. Fighting among the Four Faiths has stirred the sleeping soul of the Dark Dragon. Will you be the hero Avalonia needs? Or will you let chaos and flames consume the land??????? 20 powerful unit types ? 100 campaign stages? 30 mighty heroes? 12 devastating hero skills? A massive world map to conquer? Alliances let you fight with friends? Thrilling strategic battles????? http://twitter.com/TRINITIgames http://facebook.com/TRINITIgames

games.title: Arrows Without End
games.description: A Houyi-inspired Chinese arrow-maze puzzler. Slide arrows so they fly straight off the board and shoot down the suns. 200 hand-tuned levels, 10 sun types, 20 achievements, worldwide leaderboards, daily challenge and speedruns — endless arrows, endless puzzles.

games.title: The Last Summoner's Legacy
games.description: Come into the Monster World. You are the Tall Monster and master of the Deadly mountains. Wizards are after your area and they have placed different obstacles on your way. Your mission is to rush through the deadly mountain, do your best to do the MOST damage possible and reach towards the Wizard! TIP: Use your jumping skills -- WATCH out for obstacles and Evil Sparrow.  Can you get to the Wizards before they conquer your deadly mountain? Can you side-swipe the traps set for you by evil forces? FLIP for Tall Monster Jump now.

games.title: Trampoline to Tomorrow
games.description: Inspired by The Walking Dead.Zombie Apocalypse is here and walkers are everywhere.There is nowhere to hide and the only way to survive is to kill the dead before they get to you and eat your brains.Brace yourself and survive the dawn of the dead.Go for a headshot and better aim good before they reach you.Protect your end of the street and live another day.WARNING! This game is not for the faint hearted.

games.title: Operation MAGNO
games.description: Operation MAGNO is a cool game about a sci-fi grappling hook gun. Throughout the game, you will face various (possibly deadly) obstacles, that MAY "Kill you" BUT, that isnt a problem, right..?

games.title: Plow-A-Lot
games.description: A cozy snow-plowing game about the quiet satisfaction of a perfectly cleared lot. Plow at your own pace through soft snowfall and drifting piano, with no timers and no pressure. When you're in the mood for more, switch on the optional Robot Snowpocalypse mode and fend off waves of rogue machines.

games.title: Anomaly Watchout!
games.description: Monitor the cameras of a haunted mansion, find and fix over 40 different anomalies, and keep yourself safe across three difficulty levels in this atmospheric observation horror game. Can you survive the hardest shift?

games.title: Orderfall
games.description: ¿Presumes de buena memoria? ¿Tienes los reflejos de un lince?Demuéstralo en Farm Animals - Simon-. Un planteamiento sencillo que necesitará de todos tus reflejos.Seleccionas los animales en el orden correcto, pero cuidado.. no siempre estarán quietos esperandote.Un juego para gente de 0 a 99 años que busquen pasar un rato entretenido usando el cerebro, con unos gráficos divertidos y un planteamiento original

games.title: Stellarite Miner
games.description: Stellarite Miner is a relaxing incremental game about mining asteroids in space. Blast rocks with your powerful laser, collect resources, upgrade your ship, and keep growing until you become the greatest asteroid miner in the universe.

games.title: Pickleball Tycoon
games.description: Pickleball Tycoon is an idle tycoon game about building a pickleball business across four venues. Open 30 businesses, hire managers to run them while you are away, face a rival from the tennis club, and play four minigames. One purchase, no ads, fully offline.

games.title: Ember District
games.description: Test your memory in this super simple, but extremely challenging game. How far can you get before you fail? - Compare your score to others via the Game Center leaderboards.- Obtain all the achievements and show the world you are the best.Memory Beats randomizes colors and sounds every level. To beat the game you need to play the pattern back without losing all your bonuses.This is not entirely a music game. Patterns are made at random. The purpose of the game is to test your memory and hearing abilities.

games.title: Yume Tenshi
games.description:
Yume Tenshi—Journey through Reisuki’s dreams. Explore the spirit world, collect mystical transformations, and go through the biggest 8-bit Yume Nikki inspired game ever.

Transformations unlock new secrets and areas, encouraging experimentation and multiple playthroughs to see it all.

games.title: Abyzou Rituals: The Manson Case
games.description: THIS IS NOT A GAME. IT’S A RITUAL DISGUISED AS ONE. House 12 was abandoned after a massacre, a satanic ceremony, and the disappearance of everyone involved. Later, the surviving archive resurfaced, only for you to find it. Every ritual requires consent. Clicking "Wishlist it" may be yours.

games.title: Loanwords: A Multilingual Library
games.description: Test your luck in the high-stakes casino world. Slotventure is an all-in-one casino in your pocket. Spin the reels of well-known and new slot machines, earn unique bonuses and have fun with mini-games that will make your balance grow insanely! Prove that with 2 Ways Royal you can hit the big Jackpot of your dreams! Play anywhere, anytime – download the game for free, get an excellent starting bankroll and start raking in the money.Unlock fantastic new slot machines step by step –“Spy tricks”, “Sport” and “Knights”. Top the charts – the closer you are to being Number 1, the bigger your daily prize gets! Roll the dice for an opportunity to receive special bonuses and build a unique collection of game achievements. Take full advantage of the mini-games – they will make you even richer! And don't forget about those Aces up your sleeve – the best ones will give you a life-time opportunity to hit it big.You can play Slotventure from several devices using just one Facebook account. The unique bankroll management system will let you choose how much money you want to bet with anyparticular slot, and help you avoid a downstreak. But even if luck is not on your side at some point, you can always add funds by taking advantage of our regular sales and special offers.

games.title: Hellternum
games.description: ??DESIGN YOUR Pet House!?? Have you ever wanted to design and decorate Pet House? Now you can in Pet House designer. Become a superstar designer as you decorate and expand your Pet House! Customize every element of your Pet House: furniture,decor, food,toy and more. Increase your Room's value and collect income in Pet House designer. ??Pet House - CARTOON STYLE?? Incredible! Nearly 200 cartoon style items to customize your Pet House with! You are the princess and it is your Pet House. FEATURES: ? Hundreds of stylish items to customize your villa. ? Four types of Pet House to be designed. ? Sell your creation to get more cash. ? Intuitive and easy to play for all ages. ? Share your home with your friends over Facebook ? Play with families--Have more fun.

games.title: Ignite: The Ritual
games.description: Face the Demonic Mother as 2-4 Survivors. Complete the ritual, find and burn the cursed dolls, and work together to escape the haunted house alive.

games.title: Legion Was Here
games.description: Steal a face. Study a life. Survive the conversation.

games.title: Astrolite
games.description: Astrolite is an arcade-styled bullet heaven in a race against time. Conquer each planet before the forces of the galaxy overpower you. The Galaxy stands united. The World Guardians prepare a final stand against their greatest enemy... that enemy... is you.

games.title: Order: The New Dawn
games.description: Order: The New Dawn is a colony sim with space adventure. As a legendary captain from the United Stellar, build a base on the desert planet New Terra and face the perils of the Wastespace—how will you shape the destiny of the stars?

games.title: Feudal Craft
games.description: Immerse yourself in an exciting medieval settlement simulator where you will have to fight for your place in the feudal hierarchy. Use a smart strategy to develop your settlement. After all, it is the skills and equipment of each peasant that can make the difference.

games.title: CyberSushi
games.description: CyberSushi is a fast arcade roguelite where tiny cybernetic sushi heroes race through collapsing dimensions. Chain streaks to trigger WASABI, fill Sushi Surge, stack wild Sushi Hacks, build your roster, and chase one more impossible run.

games.title: ROLLA
games.description: BREAKING NEWS! Downtown is being terrorised by a rolling mass of pulsing flesh! Eyewitnesses describe the scene as “crunchy arcade destruction where survival blends with score-chasing!”. What is this creature!? What are its motives!? Is it really the villain here!? Back to you in the studio.

games.title: Murder Castle
games.description: After trying to start a new life, you find yourself trapped in H.H. Holmes' Murder Castle. Your mission is to escape his prison of death. Each room presents you with a new challenge and reveals something about the story behind H.H. Holmes. Can you escape the architect of death?

games.title: Deunocta
games.description: In a realm where witchcraft evolved along side technology, a lone marauder, Cassidy Chrome seeks vengeance against a tyrannical demi god who enslaves souls to conquer worlds and prolong his immortality. Cassidy, trained in the black arts fights against undead corrupted entities in a forsaken world.

games.title: Keysaster
games.description: On your way to meet a friend at a cafe, you suddenly black out for reasons unknown.... awakening in a place that is clearly not the human world. If you want to survive, evade hostile entities and search for key items to escape.

games.title: Miner Crysis
games.description: Miner Crysis is a 2D sci-fi mining adventure where you pilot a drill-ship to explore a collapsing moon held together by a mysterious crystal machine. Mine resources, battle alien threats, find secret rooms, defeat bosses, and buy powerful upgrades to grow stronger and progress.

games.title: Labyrinth Knights
games.description: Conquer the shifting labyrinth and return with the spoils of your journey!

games.title: Trash Day
games.description: Team up with your raccoon squad in this physics-based co-op adventure for up to 6 players. Scavenge trash, fill your stolen wagon, and haul it to Raccoon Paradise. Live your best raccoon life.

games.title: Evard The Hermit: Through Fears
games.description: Evard can absorb other people's fears and phobias. But this gift is also his biggest curse. Step into his story and uncover the truth about his origins. Explore a 2D medieval world, find the sources of various fears, and defeat them.

games.title: Legion Breaker
games.description: Legion Breaker is an active incremental game about growing a novice wizard into an unstoppable battlemage. Unlock powerful spells, raise a holy army, and crush undead hordes across expanding battlefields on your way to the Necromancer King.

games.title: My Lost Card Collection
games.description: My Lost Card Collection. the game.

games.title: Magnyard
games.description: Build an automated recycling yard, equip your drones, and swallow waves of waste that only get heavier.The trucks come whatever happens, and none of them can be turned away. Scrap, rubble, e-waste, batteries: everything they dump in your yard has to be sorted, shredded and sold before the next one pulls up.Your drones rip a wreck off the ground with a magnet and drop it down the hopper, the shredder spits metal, the conveyors load the warehouse, the selling takes care of itself.Then the next wave is announced, heavier. You don't lose by running out of money: you lose when the queue blocks the access lane and the yard shuts down.Shred or Sink.THE YARDLay out the intake zone, the shredder, a warehouse and the drone hangar, then grow the line: depollution plant, crusher, dismantler, compost shredder,  battery neutraliser.Six waste families arrive as the waves go by, scrap, drums and tyres, rubble,  e-waste, green waste, batteries. Each one needs its machine and the right drone  tool: magnet, clamshell bucket or grapple.Conveyors link every machine to a warehouse, which sells on its own. Let one fill up and everything behind it stops.THE PRESSURETrucks queue on the access lane and none of them can be turned away. Four bays: if the queue stays blocked for twelve seconds, the yard shuts down.Every five waves a heavy convoy is announced a wave ahead : a wrecked car, a bus shell, a digger, a plane wreck, and your drones strip it where it lands.Overdrive doubles a machine's throughput for fifteen seconds. Do it three times in a row and it breaks down at the worst possible moment.BETWEEN WAVES, BETWEEN RUNSEvery wave you clear deals three cards and you keep one: technologies, grants, contracts, and pacts that trade a sharp bonus for a cost you accept.A run lasts twenty waves, then carries on in endless mode. The debrief shows exactly where it broke, wave by wave.Reputation unlocks new sites, starting kits and six difficulty levels that stack their constraints. The finds album and the achievements carry over from run to run.GOOD TO KNOWMouse only. The interface needs at least 880 px of width, there is no mobile version.

games.title: Hungry Horrors
games.description: Hungry Horrors is a roguelite deck-building adventure where cooking is your weapon of choice against mythical monsters from British and Irish folklore. Prepare and serve authentic regional dishes to appease these creatures and progress through a world where culinary skills can mean the difference between survival and an unexpected end.

games.title: PigPonyPocalypse
games.description: Four bosses that punish every mistake. Learn the patterns, die, try again. On True Challenge, every boss gets new phases and mechanics. No leveling, no grind, just skill. And on the global leaderboard, only one thing counts: how much DPS you can squeeze out.

games.title: Not an NPC Game
games.description: NOT AN NPC GAME is a competitive skill-based game about trapping enemies, predicting their next move, and escaping situations you probably shouldnât survive. Place walls, control the arena, pull off impossible outplays, and climb a brutal ranked ladder where every mistake matters.

games.title: Cozy Tales
games.description: Build a party of adorable adventurers in this relaxing idle RPG. Battle automatically, hunt for equipment with random stats, mix skills and set bonuses, and challenge bosses as you explore a colorful fantasy world at your own pace.

games.title: Deep Dish Dungeon
games.description:
Deep Dish Dungeon is a dungeon crawler and exploration game that rewards curiosity and resourcefulness. In an atmospheric environment, explore corridors, rooms and passageways solo or with up to two friends, and gather resources to improve your camping site. Craft tools and cook nourishing meals to bolster strength throughout the journey, and unravel the enigma that lies within the shadows.

Forage and scavenge as you traverse through the dungeon's bountiful depths. Between your journeys, return to camp and plan your next steps by the fire. Use the resources you find to craft new tools and cook a hearty meal. Remember that food is progress: over time, unlock recipes that have different effects on your stats.

Fortune favors the bold. Take your time to investigate every shadow, solve every puzzle, and open every door. The dungeon will reveal its secrets only if you are patient and persistent. Learn how to defeat enemies with diverse behaviors, discover coveted treasures, and never take a hint for granted.

games.title: Abracademia
games.description: Become a wizard, and a thumping good one! Abracademia is a cozy mage idle life-sim that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play. Pick a coven, manage your daily routine, learn spells, make friends, embark on adventures, and pass exams on your way to graduation.

games.title: Kaze No Doragon: Ascension
games.description: Kaze No Doragon: Ascension is a retro inspired, ATB-styled RPG where you fight enemies and acquire artifacts to attain your true power to save your hometown, Par-Tag-Gon, from destruction.

games.title: Attic Antiquities
games.description: Precious dolls haunted by evil spirits have appeared on your doorstep. Use the tools of the Beaufort Family Workshop to exorcise them and learn why they've come to you.

games.title: Race on Stream!
games.description: Little cars. Big grudges. Race solo, with Steam friends, or turn Twitch chat into your rivals. Upgrade your car, build your own tracks, throw a chair into the race, or leave it all behind for a long drive and some music.

games.title: Soul Saver
games.description: Save the world's souls from the dead the Lich King awakened! Choose a hero, evolve your weapon with every boss you defeat, and shape your own build across a Soul Tree of 100+ nodes in this pixel-art top-down action roguelite.

games.title: Airport Madness Evolution
games.description: A fast-paced air traffic management sim where you route planes, manage runways and gates, and grow a single dirt airstrip into a sprawling international hub across five distinct locations.

games.title: BitWise
games.description: Close the loop and the lamp lights. Build the relay, the gate, the adder, the latch, the counter, and a machine that reads Morse. Every circuit runs on a real simulator, and the parts you build become parts you build with. 223 levels, working with electricity and the machines people made from it.

games.title: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel To Me
games.description: A melancholic first-person adventure through a dreamlike, half-remembered nowhere. Explore, encounter its strange inhabitants, and solve puzzles as you unravel a story about the fragility of existence.

games.title: Cone & Crest
games.description: Cone & Crest is a love letter to grassroots solo motorsports. Compete in autocross events, short road courses and hill climb solo races, driving dozens of customizable cars with easy-to-learn controls in stylized environments. In Cone & Crest, courses are short, restarts are instant, and the only thing on the line is your personal best.Controls are pick-up-and-play, but body roll, squat, dive, and lift-off oversteer all determine how you get through a corner. The difference between a good line and a great one is measured in tenths of a second. Cone & Crest features three distinct track types:AutocrossBoulevard (short technical road courses)Hill Climbs (separated into short sprints and full climbs)The campaign takes you from local parking lot sprints where cones dictate the track, all the way to the summit where you'll find cone-free sector gates on mountain switchbacks with elevation climbs.44 cars across seven classes, from economy hatchbacks to open-wheel formula cars. Swap engines, strip weight, dial in suspension, change tires and more. The parts catalog shows Performance Index updates in real-time, so you always know which class your build will land in.Build or generate courses across forests, deserts, alpine passes, and more, in any season. Set the weather and time of day, then run the same layout at noon or under lights.Pause any run, frame the shot, and save it.Design your own course layout, or a whole league with custom rules, and share it with your friends using the generated text codes. Telemetry is recorded for every race giving you the tools you need to master your line. Telemetry includes:Heat mapsSpeed tracesSector splitsRun-vs-run comparisons against your personal best ghost

games.title: Atlantis Fantasy: Reborn
games.description:
When Zeus unleashed his wrath upon Atlantis, the proud city was struck down and swallowed by the waves. 

But all is not lost. In Atlantis Fantasy, choose to play as a god or goddess and answer Poseidon’s call to restore his fallen kingdom. 

Through strategic management, mythology, and city-building, forge a new underwater empire worthy of the Olympians.

games.title: Just Dance: Decades of Hits
games.description:
IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE SPANNING 6 DECADES
Each decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades.

DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWS

- "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny

games.description: Demon God Story is an HD-2D action shooting game. In order to solve the expansion of corrupting particles in the Skeleton Demon Domain and the Skeleton God's ambition, the protagonist embarks on a journey of conquest.

games.title: For The Cat! Sorcerer's Revenge
games.description: They killed your cat. Fatal mistake. In this magic-infused bullet-heaven roguelike, develop your wizard, upgrade and evolve spells, collect items, and create unstoppable builds while battling hordes of enemies.

games.title: Witch Cabin Cleanup
games.description: Witch's Cabin Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 5,313 curios in a cluttered witch's cabin. Clean, learn spells, and restore order in a calm and atmospheric environment.

games.title: Mushroom Marketplace
games.description: Run a whimsical mushroom café by day and explore a quiet village by night in this cozy tea-brewing roguelike!

games.title: Hockey Coach Dynasty
games.description: Morphball's mission is simple; get to the checkered flag in as few shots as possible.In this award winning game, maneuver Morphball through a beautiful but hazardous landscape.Some situations require you take advantage of Morphball’s special ability to change forms.Become a balloon, rock or one of several other forms to acquire special powers that will allow you to successfully navigate each level.Avoid lasers, black holes and many other dangerous obstacles as they will bring Morphball’s journey to an end.Collect stars along the way and see if you can complete all 50 exciting levels!http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oPUbWV0fPJI

games.description: You have invited friends over for a movie night ! Everything is ready except pop-corn,  it's your task to full everybody's bowls ! Don't worry it won't be that hard, in fact it's really simple, each time a popcorn pop on the screen, tap it, try to tap as much as you can. at first they will pop one by one, but the more time goes by, the more popcorn will appear on screen at the same time, will you be fast enough to tap them all ??Simple control,  The Popcorn Tap Game is a great way to kill time when you want to fix a quick game craving or when you have time to kill ! You have 2 levels of difficulties, so it's great for people all age.

games.title: Security Duty
games.description: Security Duty is a first-person horror game where you work the night shift as a school security guard. Patrol the school, encounter dangerous entities with unique behaviors, and complete your night shift safely.

games.title: Bad Bunnies - Beyond Brackenridge
games.description: ABC Teach The SnakeFun and Challenging game that lets kids learn the ABC .

games.title: BABEL: Invent a Way
games.description: Existing languages are forbidden. Exchange only five symbols—↑ ↓ ← → •—to share what each of you knows, complete magical rituals, and break the seal. What begins as five simple symbols gradually grows into a one-of-a-kind language shared only by the two of you. Two players only.

games.title: One More Wave (Bilboldev)
games.description: Pick your loadout and fight through waves of enemy planes, UFOs and oversized bosses. Fly solo or with a friend, chase high scores, and see if you can survive just one more wave.

games.title: Backrooms: Escape
games.description:
Trapped. Alone. And something is watching you. Explore the endless Backrooms, survive what lurks inside, and find a way out before it finds you.

You weren’t supposed to end up here.
One wrong step and reality is gone. Now you’re trapped inside the Backrooms — an endless maze of empty rooms, buzzing lights, dark corridors, and places that feel disturbingly familiar.
There is a way out. Somewhere.
Explore unsettling environments, search for clues, navigate confusing corridors, and stay alert. The deeper you go, the less you can trust what you see — and you may not be alone.
ESCAPE THE BACKROOMS
Find your way through a labyrinth where every corridor can lead deeper into the unknown. Pay attention to your surroundings and search for the path forward.
SURVIVE THE UNKNOWN
Silence doesn’t mean safety. Strange entities may be closer than you think. Know when to move, when to hide, and when to run.
EXPLORE LIMINAL WORLDS
Wander through eerie rooms, endless hallways, abandoned spaces, and surreal environments inspired by the unsettling atmosphere of the Backrooms.
STAY ALERT
Every corner can hide a clue, a new path… or something you wish you hadn’t found.
CAN YOU FIND THE EXIT?
Enter the Backrooms and discover how far you’re willing to go to escape.

games.title: SHADOW OF THE KINGDOM
games.description: Your three heroes fight on their own. What you command is hatred. A real-time party RPG built on MMO combat, not turns: chain weapon skills within 4 seconds, burst them with magic for 4x damage, and keep the aggro pinned on your shield. Past the shifting dungeons waits a 100-floor abyss.

games.description: Draw your own machine in a sketchbook and send them into WWII's great battles. Every stroke matters: armor only guards the side you draw it on, long guns tip over on short tracks, and balloons make anything fly. 108 battlefields, 17 legendary bosses.

games.title: The Name Only She Knew
games.description: She was born to be a sacrifice 216 years in the making — until she found something more interesting than dying, and walked out of her cell. A hand-drawn, frame-by-frame animated visual novel from Hong Kong: read, choose, then mash, drive, drag, fight and search your way through her escape.

games.description: Race the clock in this new, free, turn-based game with friends!Link up directly with Facebook and choose any opponent you would like from your Facebook friend list. Or, take your chances playing a random opponent!The game-play is simple: try to figure out what the picture depicts before time runs out! With hundreds of words and counting, the fun never ends!Sleek and user-friendly interface easily allows you to connect with Facebook and invite friends that do not have the app.Features:- Best of 5 round match gameplay- Earn coins to unlock specials- Hundreds of professional-grade photos with more being added daily!- Facebook Login- Display Facebook friends with install- Push notifications- Auto refresh for real-time scores!*****NOTE: This app requires an internet connection and a Facebook login.*****

games.title: ChineseGaokao
games.description: The core gameplay is QTR, which mainly includes learning knowledge points, acquiring learning skills, and taking exams. After 30 weeks or upon early active application, students will participate in the college entrance examination and be allocated universities and majors based on their exam scores

games.title: Adventures of Mack
games.description: Join Mack on an exciting sci-fi hero's journey through mysterious desert planets. Solve tricky puzzles, explore alien worlds, and uncover the incredible secret behind the universe's countless desert planets!

games.title: crazy woman
games.description: Avoid crazy woman that seem to spawn at every corner of your escape route.

games.description: Do you think you are knowledgable? Are you a big a fan? Prove it with Trivia From Breaking Bad! We have put together hundreds of questions from the drama TV Series. Our questions will test the novice and challenge even the most die hard Breaking Bad fans! **** Features ****- Hundreds of questions from Breaking Bad- Questions will NEVER repeat in the same round- Trophy system that rewards you as you play!- Post your scores to Game Center and challenge your friends to beat your high scores- Three awesome power-ups?
