games.title: I Was Reincarnated as a Bosozoku Hamster, So I Became a Racing Champion to Return Home
games.description: The Ninja is Back in town!And it's time to get funky on the street.Race into the thrilling worlds being a Ninja Rider - Avoid obstacles, collect coins, buy power ups and see how far you can ride!==================             FEATURES==================- Incredibly fun and endless game play- Easy control  simply TAP to jump- Awesome Power Boosters to help you on game- Play as 4 different characters- 50+ challenging levels- 4 different exciting worlds to play- Game Center Leaderboards and achievements to compete with your friends

games.title: The Pass
games.description: A clicker "game" that is also a meta commentary and parody about you purchasing it for yourself or your friends. Get Achievements, show them on your user profile. Laugh and see just how regarded you and your friends are.

games.title: Curb Hoppers
games.description: Jump fences, slide beneath barriers and hop across car roofs in a colorful suburban arcade runner. Collect coins and stars, grab helpful power-ups, unlock new runners and chase better scores through changing streets and an unlockable endless mode.

games.title: Under Review (tatraboi)
games.description: No Ads, No interruptions, just straight gaming.  A Super Charged Snail Race with many adventurous levels and jumps. Race and jump through each exciting level as the jumps get cooler and cooler. Race against your friends or other people around the world. Multi-player integration makes this game ridiculously enjoyable.

games.title: Refund This Game
games.description: Fling yourself up to the top in this “Getting Over It”-like 3D platformer! Stick your pole to walls, bend it and fling yourself with great speed! One mistake means falling all the way down. Can you reach the summit in under 2 hours and EARN that refund?!

games.title: Dub Night Live
games.description: The type of “Diet Kingdom” is arcade.You play this game after choosing one character of eight characters with various features and advantages.The calories of foods are various. Absorbing foods makes your character gain weight and avoiding foods makes your score raised.Your goal is to set the best record by avoiding as many foods as possible through horizontal movement and various items until you fail the game when your character’s weight reaches the limit.You can confirm your ability through the total ranking and the ranking of your facebook friends and get gold by inviting facebook friends to "Diet Kingdom". Like this, this game brings you the pleasure of social game.

games.title: smoke.exe
games.description: * Urban Surfer Is Wicked! ** Another Smash Hit! ** Multiplayer Is The Best! * Introducing 'Maki' .. A Little Wolf Who Loves To Surf..As He Can't Find Any Waves He'll Make Do With Whatever He Can ; ) Help Him Get His Fix & Practice His Custom Moves. Challenge Players Worldwide & Through Facebook. Get It Now While Its Free... If You Love This Little Guy Send In Your Reviews... We Will Keep The Updates Coming..

games.title: First Principles: A Calculus Platformer
games.description: Run and jump across the graphs of real functions. Every level is a curve — its derivative shapes the platforms and hazards. 40+ stages from parabolas to Riemann sums, AP Calculus BC, physics, and aerospace curves, ending in a Mandelbrot boss. A platformer that teaches real calculus.

games.title: Heart of the Machine: Kinship
games.description:
Step into the frontier of strategic roleplaying with the mind-bending storylines of Heart of the Machine - Kinship. 

New possibilities await, deepening the lore of the game and unlocking new avenues of exploration and expansion for The Machine Intelligence. 

Build a giant spider mech that will blot out the sun, pour pain into art, explore a biological mystery, or plant forests and upend the hierarchy of sapient species. 

Your choices impact the future of the city – or the entire planet.

games.title: Overdue (Dry Fox Studio)
games.description: OVERDUE is a co-op multiplayer horror game for up to 6 players set in a massive shifting industrial warehouse where survival is based on productivity. Navigate through an anomalous industrial maze, manage your orders, and fulfill your mandate in time.

games.title: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands
games.description: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands is a relaxing puzzle game where you must organize found futuristic loot in your backpack in a tidy way. Find unknown artifacts and learn details about the faraway lands... at least supposedly!

games.title: Wheel Make It
games.description: One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos. Solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

games.title: DSARTS
games.description: Drone Search and Rescue Training Simulator built by responders, for responders using real world locations. Learn drone controls then practice search patterns, camera handling, and target detection in dynamic environments where every run is different and every decision matters.

games.title: Organomancer
games.description: Run an organ trading empire in the dark underworld of Arkwright. Buy, upgrade, and sell organs across black markets. Manage your economy, dodge the police, and fulfill patient requests to dominate the underground.

games.title: Monkey Bizniz
games.description: An online co-op physics game about collecting bananas for the Monkey King's feast — fill your cart, find the summit, and try not to blame your friends when it all goes wrong.

games.title: Daily Burden
games.description: Daily Burden is a chest-opening roguelite parodying mobile games. Key prices increase. Chest contents do not. Learn to crave ads and discover powerful synergies. Do everything to keep up with rising prices… but beware of (FAKE) microtransactions!

games.title: American Cooking Simulator: Multiplayer
games.description: Cook with firearms in the most patriotic cooking simulation of all time! Team up in chaotic co-op shifts at Joe’s Freedom Burgers and experience an absolutely normal, definitely accurate version of America.

games.title: The Traveller's Sight
games.description: Vincent Dumas, an investigator with supernatural powers, is sent to a small town in France with a murky history to uncover the truth behind the death of Laurène Delgado. Using his ability to communicate with the dead, he sets out to find clues that will lead him to the killer.

games.title: Vicarius
games.description: A small handcrafted open world focused on exploration and combat. Leave your safe zone to gather the resources that will help you craft better gear. The further you go, the more dangerous it gets but the resources are also better. Dying means losing everything that you are carrying.

games.title: Life, the Universe, and Restaurants
games.description: Run a restaurant in a bizarre universe and cook for customers who call themselves "gods"! Expand your restaurant, deploy robots, and automate your kitchen. Keep business booming—and be ready to deal with any unruly customers.

games.title: NeeNee Deskpals
games.description: Want your own crew of one-of-a-kind, cute desktop companions? NeeNee Deskpals lets you make fully custom characters. Tweak bodies, outfits and lively animations. Spawn multiple pals, watch them wander freely, and interact with them anytime! Built-in focus tools keep you company day and night.

games.title: Ward Off Evil
games.description: Ward Off Evil is an open world strategy RPG set in an apocalyptic sword & sorcery world. Create your character, rally an army, and roam the wastes as you battle to avert, or bring about, the end of the Cycle.

games.title: Rythm Animal Cafe
games.description: Welcome to ​Rhythm Animal Café​! Animals' daily chaos meets funky beats: boss hype, colleague woes, your slacking, unfair blame—all become hilarious one-tap rhythm games! Simple controls, joyful groove. Feel music fuse with daily life’s warmth!

games.title: Spoofs Playland
games.description: Play, collect, and decorate! Spoofs Playland is a relaxing, family-friendly collection of point-and-click minigames where you collect decorations and bond with the Spoofs in a colorful world. Earn rewards, complete quests, buy new backgrounds and hundreds of items, and make your dream room!

games.title: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror
games.description: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror is a J-horror RPG where events unfold in real-time. Survive one night in a city where every choice you make impacts the world around you. How many deaths will you be responsible for tonight?

games.title: Battleplan
games.description: Battleplan is a historical, WW2 real-time strategy game of unparalleled realism and simulation. Fight across massive battlefields created from real-world geographic data. Create your army by customizing your order of battle and chain of command. Draw directly on the map to create elaborate plans.

games.title: Alpha Nomos
games.description:
It's time to wield the beat in Alpha Nomos, a rhythm-action roguelite where every instrument is a weapon and every fight moves to the music. Play as Cello and slice through an army of rogue puppets in a vibrant, melody-twisted world where combat pulses to the soundtrack and timing is everything.

Who knew saving the world could sound this good? Join Cello and her friends as they explore their ruined world, fight murderous puppets, and uncover the mysteries of the powerful force known as music. What caused the destruction of this world? What is music? What is Alpha Nomos? All these answers await Cello as she fights to bring balance back to a corrupted world.

Time your moves to the beat to unleash show-stopping combos and perfectly choreographed chaos. Master the rhythm, gather living sound, and breathe life back into a world that moves to the music you make. Prepare for a run where every strike, every upgrade, and every note pulls you deeper into the song.

games.title: Amsterdam: Autumn Street
games.description:
Clean up the streets of Amsterdam!
Pick up fallen leaves one by one, keep the city spotless, and upgrade your equipment as you work your way through the beautiful autumn streets.

games.title: Colorbound
games.description: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

games.title: Dinerz
games.description: Run your own diner! Cook juicy burgers, crispy fries, fresh pizza and many other delicious meals. Manage chaotic orders, serve hungry customers, and unlock exotic ingredients. Play alone or team up with up to 4 friends!

games.title: LampMan!
games.description: LampMan! is a 2d action-platformer featuring three playable characters you can switch between at any time. Master their abilities, conquer vibrant levels, and restore light to LampWorld!

games.title: Pieps Fruit Fall
games.description: Catch the falling fruit before it hits the ground! Pieps Fruit Fall is a cute arcade skill game with a sweet pixel art style, varied levels, and plenty of addictive gameplay.

games.title: Spy Drops Gaiden
games.description: Infiltrate enemy bases and undertake a series of covert ops in thrilling, old school 2D stealth action.

games.title: Burn With Me
games.description: Burn With Me is a story-centric deckbuilder filled with cozy dread and occultic mysteries. In order to summon a Personal Demon you'll master inventive gameplay with position-based synergies, and permanently burn your cards and your soul.

games.title: The Story Adam Left Behind
games.description: This is a branching visual novel with multiple endings, centered around a public incident. Depending on your perspective, you will only be able to see part of what happened. And your choices will ultimately shape the fate of the protagonist and those around him.

games.title: Time To Wake Up
games.description: You're stuck in a dream. Blink and change your surroundings to escape the shadows of your past.

games.title: Inspector Sommers in: Ouroborian Madness
games.description: Inspector Sommers in: Ouroborian Madness: The escape room that breaks the laws of physics and time. Investigation, time travel, and a warping mansion await in this Cold War-era mystery adventure.

games.title: Idle Vapor Legends
games.description: *Idle Vapor Legends* is an idle RPG focused on AFK combat and effortless loot collection.

games.title: Don't Give Up
games.description: Don't Give Up is an incremental, minimalist and emotional game about loss. As you gain more passions, friends and dreams they become harder to manage. Each one ignoring your weakening cries as they slowly leave your circle and life. Is it possible to stop everything you love from leaving you?

games.description: As the sole survivor of your team, it is up to you track down the enemies responsible and extract vengeance for the natives of your city.Fight fearlessly and gun down hordes of enemy troops as they plan a attack on your city. It’s time to say not to mess with the baddest around. The enemy is a stronger side, but you are still a tough nut!! Show the enemies what you can do!! Let the fight begin….Features:-50 levels to clear-Collect starts after killing enemies for bonus points-Enemies start attacking after clearing 20 levels-3 lives throughout the gameComplete the mission and emerge as the ultimate savior…..

games.title: Phantom Fleet
games.description: Command Hollow King in a naval action roguelite. Sink ships, harvest souls, and recruit a ghost fleet. Shape your build with upgrade cards and five automatic skill slots. Break blockades across ten seas, then rise stronger after sinking with permanent shipyard upgrades.

games.title: Warring States: Seven Hegemons
games.description: Rule a state in ancient China's Warring States era in this single-player, turn-based strategy game. Manage resources, recruit historical figures, enact reforms and navigate diplomacy. Grain spoils, armies need upkeep and conquered cities need pacification. Can your economy sustain your ambitions?

games.title: Sokoban: Ancient Ruins
games.description: DODGEMAN******The player controls a stickman. The object is to avoid icicles and catch snowflakes for a chance to get points or even a score multiplier.GET IT NOW BEFORE THE PRICE GOES UP!Any questions can be sent to: eliotman24@comcast.net

games.title: Legends of the Pitch
games.description: Football meets roguelike deckbuilding. Choose your nation, build your team, and combine cards in tactical battles. Upgrade your deck, explore branching paths, and defeat legendary bosses across five regions on your journey to football glory.

games.title: Timber Knight
games.description: Dodge the branches and chop the endless tree! "Timber Knight" is a fast-paced arcade action game that tests your reflexes. Experience satisfying hit-stops, survive the ever-accelerating time limit, and chop your way to the top of the World Leaderboard!

games.title: COMMANDO INFERNO
games.description: Malevolence has risen and it's coming for your life and for your soul.  The world around you is on fire.  It has morphed and its nature has no benevolence left anymore.  This is your life, what remains of it, fight for it with all the might left in your body and your soul.

games.title: Last On Duty
games.description: "Last On Duty" is a first-person psychological horror game. You must carefully observe your surroundings, complete various tasks, and ultimately make a decisive choice.

games.title: Bandit Simulator TD
games.description: This is a "Tower Defense + Base Building" game where you establish a bandit stronghold from scratch. With "Tower defense" at its core, you can ambush travelers, develop characters through profession and equipment systems, and expand your stronghold by researching, forging, and constructing!

games.title: Graffiti Survivor
games.description: Survive on scratch paper: pick a nervous doodle, fight waves of geometry foes, and upgrade as you go.

games.title: Meow Garden
games.description: Welcome to Cat Island, a cozy farming sim where cats sprout from the soil! Plant seeds, care for your cats, and discover over 40 breeds. Decorate your home, train your cats, fulfill orders, and grow your own cat estate.

games.title: Car Drift Simulator 2027
games.description:
Choose your car and start your drifting journey.

Feel the tires scream, the engine roar, and the asphalt disappear beneath you as you push every corner to the limit! Enter a high-speed world of precision drifting where split-second reactions, perfect control, and fearless driving are the keys to becoming a true drift master.

Choose your favorite car from the very beginning and hit the track with nothing holding you back. Throw your car into every corner, control the slide, balance the throttle, and chase the perfect drift as you take on increasingly demanding challenges. Every turn is an opportunity to prove your skill, and every mistake can cost you the perfect run.

Key Features:
• 5 Cars Available From the Start: Choose from 5 unique cars and start drifting immediately.
• 20 Challenging Levels: Master 20 tracks filled with demanding corners and technical turns.
• Advanced Drift Physics: Control every slide with responsive handling and realistic weight transfer.
• Master Every Curve: Improve your lines and drifting technique across every challenging track.
• Immersive Racing Audio: Feel every drift with roaring engines and screeching tires.

games.title: Rusty Prison: Horror
games.description:
You probably shouldn't be here.

You found an abandoned prison.

Naturally, you decided to explore it.

Rusty Prison: Horror is a creepy exploration game where you wander through a forgotten, rust-covered prison looking for something cool to find. Explore dark cells, strange rooms, broken hallways, and places that probably should have stayed locked.

games.title: Crazy Lamb RC
games.description:
A wild RC racing adventure with a lamb behind the handlebars!

Take control of a crazy toy trike and put your driving skills to the test with realistic physics and fast-paced RC racing.

Race against opponents, beat your best times in Time Trial, or explore freely in Free Roam. Play with a friend in 2-player split-screen or challenge them through Wireless Play!

Get behind the handlebars and let the crazy RC racing begin!

games.title: Bounty Hunter Horrors
games.description: "Link Nodes HD" is a simple yet addictive puzzle game.Many people have the experience playing this kind of game,I believe that there will be a lot of players like this game.Game operation1.Selected and drag the red button (note the square red button can not be moved), the red line between the two red buttons will move together with the drag button.2.When all node online games on clearance.With the increase of the level, the difficulty of the game will increase

games.title: The Boogeyman
games.description: Inspired by the Argentine folklore legend of The Boogeyman, several children have disappeared from neighboring farms, and rumors point to a mysterious presence roaming the countryside at night. Explore the area, use everything at your disposal to find out where he is, and keep your son safe.

games.title: Classic Video Poker
games.description: Experience classic video poker your way.Choose from 11 video poker games, including Jacks or Better, Bonus Poker, Joker Poker, Deuces Wild and high-action bonus variants. Whether you're learning the game or know exactly which cards to hold, there's always another hand waiting.Make the experience your own with eight themes. Keep it old-school with Classic, enjoy the clean style of Modern, unwind to the sights and sounds of Beachcomber, explore the colorful Day of the Dead-inspired worlds of Juego de la Vida and Juego de la Muerte, or take in Las Vegas by night with Midnight and by day with High Noon.Customize your play, explore different pay tables, track your statistics, and use built-in instructions, hand references and strategy guides to sharpen your game.Play at your own pace. Chase the perfect hand. Hunt for the royal flush.Eleven games. Eight themes. One more hand.

games.title: Broadside Battle Arena
games.description: Broadside Battle Arena is a tactical fleet-combat game set in the Star Atlas universe. Spend 145 fleet points on any mix of 41 hulls from ten manufacturers then fight it out in a single arena where range, facing and timing decide the exchange.

games.title: The Night Shift (MediaVerse Labs)
games.description: The night shift is yours, detective. Read the file, catch the forgery, break the alibi, and stamp CHARGE or RELEASE before the clock runs out. Every verdict echoes. 7 nights, 8 endings, fully voiced in English and Spanish.

games.title: Woodland Trail
games.description:
Take a hike!

Welcome to Woodland Trail, a relaxing walking simulator where the journey is just as important as the destination.

Explore a calm woodland filled with hidden paths, quiet corners, and collectible melons waiting to be discovered. Take your time, wander wherever you like, and see if you can find every single melon.

Features:
>Explore a peaceful woodland at your own pace.
>Collect all the hidden melons.
>Search every path and secret spot.
>Relax and enjoy a simple, cozy adventure.

games.title: Space Tanks (Black Blowfish Software Labs)
games.description: Like a forgotten Atari classic, only from 2003: Space Tanks introduced a new artillery gameplay concept and made gravity truly intuitive to play for the first time. This is the original 2003 game, not a remake. 30+ weapons, 70 tanks and strategy deliver that “just one more round” feeling.
games.publisher: Pepper  Games, Tewi (Germany), Akella (Russia), Alten8 (United Kingdom), Zapak (India)

games.title: Arcanum Idle
games.description: A study, a circle of chalk, and eight Sigils that make each other. Arcanum Idle is a deep incremental about tearing down what you built: five nested prestige layers, a Constellation you arrange by hand, and time magic paid for in resets.

games.title: 429 - Four Twenty Knight
games.description: A physics-based VR puzzle game where you smash objects, uncover the right path forward, and survive swarms of creepy bugs.

games.title: Denizen
games.description: Make a living for yourself in a city full of opportunity while you meet a variety of locals, explore unique locations, and work your way to the top in this open-world life simulator.

games.title: Uppercute
games.description: Uppercute is a 3D action platformer where, with the help of your sister and the use of your runner skills, you’ll dive into people's minds, face challenging opponents and retrieve valuable information to solve the mystery of your brother's disappearance.

games.title: Continuous Imperfection
games.description: Trapped in the world of a god with eugenic ambitions, you must prove yourself by using your parkour skills to navigate and complete a series of levels as quickly as possible. Do not be a continuous imperfection.

games.title: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen Expansion
games.description:
Dragon's Dogma 2 presented players with a deep, explorable fantasy world, challenging them to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more.

With Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen, that experience has been further enhanced through the addition of unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters.

Experience enhanced gameplay.
Embark on uncharted adventures.
Enticing value for myriad additions.

Together with your loyal Pawns, set off on an unparalleled adventure!

games.title: OBSESSED
games.description: Knock From Inside is a short (~30-minute) indie horror walking simulator with a simple, clear story and uncluttered gameplay. You play as Adam, a university student returning to his apartment to gather his last belongings before moving back home.

games.title: Lord Liberty Quest II ~Pure White~
games.description: Someone is secretly hastening the revival of the "Black Devil" that assaults the Disodart Continent every few decades. Taking the situation gravely, the royal capital entrusts the tower's investigation to a church priestess. But that priestess is a young, innocent maiden…

games.title: COLORFALL
games.description: A chaotic 1-4 player co-op match-3 game where you and your friends each control only 1 color. Survive the falling grid by pulling and throwing orbs to trigger chains and finish tasks before time runs out. If your color piles up, it’s on you to clear the path.

games.title: Soul of Dreamer
games.description: A young girl trapped in a strange world guided only by their heart and soul. jump around and explore many places to find a way out.

games.title: The Matron of Ashes
games.description: Explore the abandoned manor inherited from your grandmother. Follow the clues, purify the ritual medallions with holy water, and hide from the Matron stalking its halls. Uncover the truth buried in the past and complete the ritual before it is too late.

games.title: Capitalize
games.description: Financial life sim from 18 to retirement: job, budget, housing, broker (ETFs, stocks, gold…), business & IPO, local modes + online career. Learn compounding and the 4% rule by playing.

games.title: Botlings
games.description:
A factory automation game where workers become buildings and develop sentience.

Lead a swarm of mindless robots in a factory automation game where your workers are also your machines.

Direct your forward-walking robots through turners, splitters and bridges, transform them into production buildings, have them transport your resources, and design ever-growing production networks in all 3 dimensions. In Botlings, every robot is a resource: guide them to work, reroute their paths, or sacrifice them to construct the infrastructure your factory needs.

But be wary, the more your factory grows, the more unpredictable your workforce becomes.

games.title: Conquisterra Roguelie
games.description: A 2D roguelike about escaping a dungeon nightmare, and choosing between a comforting lie or a painful truth.

games.title: Shelf-Employed
games.description: Shelf-Employed is a first-person organization game set inside a chaotic magical warehouse. Sort thousands of packages, master useful spells, and upgrade your workflow as you turn towering piles of boxes into perfectly ordered shelves.

games.title: Hack n' Stack
games.description:
Physics meets tower defense in this chaotic party game.

Craft barricades and turrets with whatever you can find. But beware: relentless waves of enemies are coming to tear down everything you build.

games.title: Used Cars Simulator
games.description: Used Cars Simulator - trade used or stolen cars, fix and customize them, drive around, and explore the open world! Grow your business, complete quests, and have fun with a physics-based sandbox!

games.title: The Hat Man
games.description: A first-person psychological horror game inspired by The Hat Man urban legend, focusing on sleep paralysis, fear, and the terror of being unable to move.

games.title: Duckoleon
games.description: Experience (mildly) accurate historical battles from the Napoleonic era, but from the perspective of DUCKS! Duckoleon is a multiplayer FPS/TPS with strategic elements. Exciting combat with units ranging from line infantry to cavalry and artillery, historical uniforms, cute ducks and much more!

games.title: It Hears You: Together
games.description: It Hears You - a co-op horror. Escape the forest as fast as you can. Play with 1 to 6 people. Move quietly and avoid unnecessary sounds so Stag doesn’t hear you. He’s blind, but his hearing is perfect.

games.title: Sesame Street: Friends & Fun
games.description:
Welcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow.

From the moment you arrive, there’s so much to do. Join Elmo, Tango and the rest of your Sesame Street friends around the neighbourhood!

Walk around with Grover, plant a magical giant beanstalk in Abby’s Garden, find useful tools and rubber ducks in the Community Garden with Bert & Ernie, and work on your number and puzzle skills in Count von Count’s Mansion. Or cook, mix and laugh along with Cookie Monster in his Foodie Truck! Some quests may take a few tries, but you’ll work together to find a way to make the streets a brighter and happier place for everyone.

Make yourself at home! Decorate your house, unlock new mini-games, access exciting new areas of the Street, or throw and unforgettable block party. Spend time with Tango, your cheerful and furry helper or enjoy the whole adventure together with family and friends in local co-op play.

The fun and exploration never ends on Sesame Street!

JOIN THE NEIGHBORHOOD: Create your own character and join Elmo, Tango, Abby and their friends on Sesame Street.

EXPLORE THE STREET: Start at your apartment, stop by Big Bird’s cozy nest, play at the Count’s Mansion, and unlock more places.

BRING EVERYONE TOGETHER: Help the community by going on cooking, photography, and even farming quests solo or in co-op.

DISCOVER AND GROW: Use rewards to decorate your home, unlock new mini-games and access exciting new areas.

TRAVEL WITH TANGO: Take care of Tango just like she’ll take care of you as she helps you get around.

games.title: Turbo Zone: Car Royale
games.description: Turbo Zone: Car Royale is a fast-paced vehicular combat game where players race, shoot, and battle rival cars in colorful arenas. Play solo against AI or compete online in action-packed PvP matches to score points, survive, and become the last car standing.

games.title: Labyrinth of Reverie
games.description: Labyrinth of Reverie is a 3D first-person psychological horror game blending hidden-object puzzles with surreal exploration. Journey into shifting dreamscapes, from natural beauty to uncanny strangeness, as reality bleeds into the dream. Tailor objectives with 3 quest log styles to guide your path.

games.title: Kenomas
games.description: *** Do you have an eye for details? ***--- A new picture quiz game! ---In Zoom Quiz you will see an object really close up. FREEZoom Quiz is completely free to try! Just tap the download button and start playing!SIMPLE AND STYLISHPlaying is super simple! Is the picture too close? Zoom out and see if you can solve it now. You can also remove and reveal letters, and you can even use the key icon to skip a tricky question!When you complete enough levels you’re awarded free hints, which you can use later on. You can also purchase hints in the game.HUNDREDS OF QUESTIONSZoom Quiz contains hundreds of different picture challenges! How many can you solve?Can your mind and eyes work together to take on the Zoom Quiz challenge? Tap the download button and find out NOW!

games.title: Sunlit Suites
games.description: Run a cheerful hotel in Sunlit Suites. Welcome guests, clean rooms, collect earnings, and invest in upgrades as your business grows. Unlock new areas, bring in helpful staff, and find your rhythm in a colorful hotel management game.

games.description: A tiny idle RPG that lives on your desktop. Park it on your taskbar or anywhere on screen, and four heroes march through 7 acts while you work, study or play. games.title: Hair Bug
games.description: Hair Bug is a physics-based action game where you shake your head by moving the mouse left and right to remove bugs eating your hair. Protect your hair, survive increasingly challenging rounds, and aim for your best survival time and a place in the local Top 10 rankings.

games.description: Four fields. Four bouncing balls. One shared move. Control four paddles at once in a single-player brick breaker with 360 stages. Catch each rebound, grab power-ups, and clear a field to unleash more balls and firepower on the ones that remain.

games.title: 4 SCREENS, 1 LIFE
games.description: Four screens. Four characters. One life. Control all four at once in a challenging 2D platformer where one death resets every screen. Master 370 stages (10 INTRO + 360 main stages), collect every star, beat your best times, and create and share stages through Steam Workshop.

games.title: Mortality... Please
games.description: Penelope falls for a nineteen-year-old who has not aged in over a century. His face survives in yearbooks, VHS tapes, and dead forum pages. Then an elderly woman arrives with a photograph of herself beside him. A short psychological horror VN about eternal youth and the people it leaves behind.

games.title: Kemco RPG Selection Vol. 11

games.title: Eyes Behind 2
games.description: EYES BEHIND 2 is the sequel to Eyes Behind, a retro-graphics FPS survival horror game inspired by cult horror classics. The killer has been caught and is behind bars. The file is closed. So why are you still finding notes on your car?

games.title: Stancefolio
games.description: Stancefolio is an ink-wash wuxia roguelike deckbuilder. Choose one of six martial artists, combine techniques in turn-based battles, and chart your path through encounters and bosses. Upgrade your deck and unlock new cards across runs to discover your own fighting style.

games.title: Words of Power: Logos
games.description: A galaxy enslaved by ancient words. Type fast, spell true, and fight back — every word is a weapon. Duel bosses, battle across a neon-vector galaxy, and prove you're eloquent enough to save the universe. Multiplayer coming soon!

games.title: Game Market Mayhem
games.description: Game Market Mayhem is a cozy organization simulator where you sort 5,120 scattered game boxes according to their genres and platforms. Transform a massive pile of boxes into the perfect game store. Fill the shelves, unwind, and enjoy the satisfaction of everything being in order!

games.title: Ghost Clicker: Ethereal Idle
games.description: Step into the realm of ethereal ghosts in Ghost Clicker! Upgrade your click power, build automation systems, cultivate spectral wheat fields, and transcend through 20 ascension tiers to build your idle empire.

games.title: HYALOSFALL
games.description: Glass doesn't crack here. It detonates. Pilot the AEGIS through the Prism Vaults, return the Photonic Core, and turn every chain into PRISM: push the wall back, cash the flare, or buy your way out. 200 screens, 8 acts, 5 elements that react with each other.

games.title: Siege Kitchen
games.description: Keep a besieged castle alive, one meal at a time. Cook with dwindling supplies, tend the fire, and ration each batch between soldiers, civilians, and the wounded. Your kitchen must last thirty days. Not everyone can have a full bowl.

games.title: 101 Circuits
games.description: Build circuits and match waveforms across 101 electronics puzzles. Draw wires, light LEDs, and watch signals change on the oscilloscope. Learn how components work, then experiment with your own circuits in Sandbox. No programming required.

games.title: Blaster!
games.description: One Super Bomb. One Eagle. One mission with no second chance. BLASTER! is a classic Defender-style side-scrolling shooter. Fight through 20 underwater and space levels, upgrade your arsenal, take down powerful bosses, and get the Super Bomb to its target - in Original or Enhanced presentation.

games.title: Cozy Meowmory
games.description:
Build the purr-fect room and spot what’s out of place!

KEEP YOUR CAT EYES SHARP
Step into a cozy world of colorful rooms, adorable cats, and little details waiting to fool your eyes. Compare rooms carefully and find everything that has changed. Objects may move, disappear, rotate, change color, or hide somewhere you least expect!

TRUST YOUR MEOWMORY
Think you can remember every little detail? Study a room carefully, keep its layout in mind and then find what has changed without a side-by-side comparison. If things get tricky, use helpful boosters such as Highlight, Peek and Freeze to give yourself a little extra help.

CREATE YOUR PURR-FECT ROOM
Take a break from puzzling and become an interior designer! Build your own cozy rooms from scratch and make them truly yours with over 870 customization items, including furniture, decorations, plants, floors, walls and more! Arrange everything just the way you like, experiment with colors and create a cozy space for your feline friends. Collect 2 adorable kitties and watch them wander around the room as you enjoy your creation.

TWO PLAYERS, TWICE THE PURR
Challenge a friend in local multiplayer and see who can spot the differences faster! Play together on one screen, put your observation skills to the test and turn every cozy room into a little friendly competition.

games.title: Tiny Techie in Puzzle Land
games.description:
Help the crafty pink-haired gearhead complete a series of intricate puzzles in a beautiful pixel art world! Push, pull and trade places with objects to reach the end of each level! Create bridges by pushing minecarts or boxes into lakes, and navigate objects within complex railroad systems!

Buttons, boxes, minecarts, magical crystals, rails - there are too many objects and possible interactions to count! But don't worry, levels don't have a time limit and you can even skip the ones you think are too hard. Can you help the tiny techie beat puzzle land?

games.title: Two Minds One Car
games.description: Experience a unique cooperative driving adventure where teamwork is key: one player controls the steering wheel, while the other manages the gas and brake. Success depends on perfect coordination and precise timing.

games.title: 4 SCREENS, 1 MOVE
games.description: Four screens. Four slimes. One shared move. Guide them all home in a puzzle game where every direction affects all four boards. Use walls to your advantage, outwit traps, and solve 10 intro stages plus 360 main stages. Create and share your own puzzles through Steam Workshop.

games.title: Whisker Mess
games.description:
Get ready for a feline adventure filled with adorable pieces, clever combinations, and toys scattered everywhere in Whisker Mess! In this fun tile-fitting puzzle, you must place cat-shaped pieces across the board, create lines, and clear the way while earning points and making room for new moves.

By completing horizontal, vertical, and, on certain levels, even diagonal lines, you clear pieces, remove toys from the board, and turn every move into a new strategic opportunity. But be careful: blockers act as extensions of the walls and can completely change the way lines are formed!

With 30 levels divided into 3 biomes, Whisker Mess gradually introduces new challenges. As you progress, you'll encounter special toys with different behaviors, requiring you to carefully observe the board, adapt your plans, and discover how to make the most of each effect.

With no time pressure, Whisker Mess offers a relaxing and accessible experience, while still providing plenty of possibilities for those who enjoy thinking several moves ahead. With different board layouts, varied blockers, and combinations of special toys, each level brings a new challenge to test your creativity and spatial reasoning.

Fit the pieces, create lines, clear the mess, and help turn this feline chaos into pure fun!

games.title: Sugar Rush Rescue
games.description:
A tasty, retro co-op adventure.

When best friends Colby and Jack find a forest of candy, they're ready to munch! But while the boys selfishly sample the sweets, Colby's little sister is abducted by a monstrous owl! Now they must navigate a world of confections as they learn to pay attention to what matters most.

Featuring a wide range of obstacles, enemies, and levels to explore, Sugar Rush Rescue is a tasty, retro co-op adventure.

games.title: G.D.F. PHALANX: Missile Defense Protocol
games.description: Build and defend an island base in this isometric real-time strategy game. Keep your launchers fueled as incoming missiles threaten your buildings, then strike enemy islands with missiles or send in mechs to fight on the ground.

games.title: MoooooN - The cow jumps over the moon
games.description: You play as Cow, a cow who has always wanted to jump over the moon! Luckily, their friends have figured out a way it might just be possible... Jump through interesting levels and speak to a cast of silly characters as you make your way there!

games.title: ROCK CORE
games.description: Enjoy the peaceful forest in Rock Core, a relaxing incremental game. Smash rocks, sell ores, upgrade your character, and hire workers to build the an automated mining operation!

games.title: Jane Friday: After Hours
games.description: Port-City, 1997. You take the overnight security shift at the Brannigan Building and find a box of a missing detective's case tapes. Six hours until dawn. An arcade cabinet that isn't plugged in. A phone that rings at 3:17. A short, text-driven horror story with five endings.

games.title: Sealed Fortress
games.description: A dungeon-crawling, turn-based RPG in which you take a party of 3 through the treacherous halls of a castle corrupted by wild magic.

games.title: Doc Tommy: The Vig
games.description: A mob trivia game dressed up as a debt collection. You owe Doc Tommy ten thousand dollars. Answer questions about Our Business — every right answer pays the debt down, every wrong one adds to it. Reach $0 and you walk. Reach $30,000 and you don't.

games.title: Starling Ascent
games.description: Momentum-flight cave climber. One fail-safe robot's mission to bring the light back to a world gone dark. Find the power cores, carry them home, and survive the harsh caves on your ascent. Nothing but rotate and thrust to guide you in this physics-based platformer.

games.description: Build formulas and molecules with cards, arrange science Jokers and refine your deck to overcome challenges. AXIOMA is a science-themed roguelike card game spanning physics, chemistry and mathematics, with a classic mode, tutorials and text in five languages.

games.title: Day/Night Events
games.description: An exploration horror adventure RPG where you unravel mysteries hidden in the silence of the night. Collect clues to uncover the unsettling truth.

games.title: Don't trust anyone
games.description: Explore realistic modern Tokyo in this 3rd-person open walking simulation. Stroll through authentic streets and quiet alleys, ride bicycles and drive vehicles, enter houses, and encounter locals living their daily lives. Take in the urban atmosphere, but remember: do not trust anyone.

games.title: BumpBall
games.description: Created to accompany the book Marmalade SDK Mobile Game Development Essentials, published by Packt Publishing, this game demonstrates the use of the Marmalade SDK for displaying 3D graphics, playing sound and music, getting player inputs and much more besides.Over the course of ten chapters the book teaches video game programmers how to use their existing C++ development skills to develop iOS games.This game evolves throughout the book as new functionality provided by Marmalade is explored so readers can see how it has been built from beginning to end.

games.title: Jingai Makyo: Dice Legion
games.description: **Jingai Makyo: Dice Legion** is a 3v3 dice-battle RPG where you recruit a colorful cast of supernatural beings. Customize the skills on each character’s dice, combine unique traits and equipment, build your own party, and journey across Japan to challenge powerful foes!

games.title: The Anomalarian
games.description: The house is lying to you. Notice what changed, decide if it's safe, and live with being wrong. A first-person psychological horror game where every room hides an anomaly, your sanity is the only health bar you have, and the things in the dark are watching to see if you'll believe your own eyes.

games.title: System Lords
games.description: Build your empire in a living spiral galaxy. Explore worlds, command planets, travel through Stargates, research advanced technology, form alliances, wage war, and conquer your rivals in this deep online strategy game.

games.title: Nightmare World
games.description: The girl has been trapped in the Nightmare World. There, a red demon is chasing her! The key to escape is the “Emblem”! You must guide the girl to freedom! If you stop, it will devour you! Escape from the Nightmare World! (4 difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, Hard, Nightmare)

games.title: Mother Simulator
games.description:
Rule the house and become Super Mom!

Become a fabulous supermom in this funny 3D family life and farming game! Can you manage a busy home, run a backyard farm, and stay stylish daily?

Balance the ultimate daily routine! From dressing yourself and your three energetic kids to babysitting a lazy husband who refuses to get off the couch, your hands are always full. Cook meals, clean messes, soothe crying babies, and then head outside to milk the cows and tend your farm animals. Can you survive the daily rush?

Key Features:
• Hilarious 3D Family Simulator: Experience a fast-paced, comedic life sim. Juggle non-stop chores, cook family meals, change dirty diapers, and keep your home in order.
• Manage Your Lazy Husband: He needs constant supervision! Turn on his favorite TV shows, hand-deliver his snacks, and clean up his messes before chaos breaks out.
• Backyard Homestead & Farming: Step outside to run your personal mini-farm. Feed the animals, milk the cows, and manage your outdoor chores to keep supplies stocked.
• Fashion, Makeup & Dress-Up: Looking fabulous is half the battle! Customize your supermom with a huge wardrobe of chic dresses, trendy hairstyles, and stylish accessories.
• Addictive Time Management: Upgrade your tools, unlock new rooms, and challenge your multitasking skills. Face an endless, unpredictable daily schedule.

games.title: Polda 5.5
games.description: Starověký Egypt byl vyspělou civilizací, která měla potenciál trvat navždy. Pak se do toho ovšem vložil náš neohrožený detektiv Pankrác. Ten na konci minulého dílu zůstal v Egyptě a stal se faraonem. Zjistítěte s námi co tam vyváděl a jak se vlasntě vrátil zpátky do Lupan.

games.title: Hamsuri : Bomb Festival
games.description: Kawaii hamsters, explosive droppings and couch rivalries! Trap your friends, stash bombs in your cheeks and burrow out of trouble. An arena party brawler for 1–4 local players, with CPU opponents, changing stage hazards and a festival championship.

games.title: Space Pads
games.description: Put your Steam Deck trackpads to intense use as you fight endless enemies, bosses, and difficulties in this old-school, arcade-like shoot out. With a play area mapped as a 1:1 of your right trackpad for targeting, experience the fun of the most precise and intense use of Deck trackpad aiming.

games.title: Shape Up!
games.description: Be a circle, a square, or a triangle - and change your mind mid-jump. A neon platformer about the right shape at the right instant. 53 hand-built rooms, a full level editor, and up to four players racing the same room. Need a rest, try building a level together, multiplayer level editor!

games.title: Motorcycle Night Ride
games.description: Imagine riding a motorcycle freely on an endless highway at night, embraced by the silence of the night. Cruising under the glow of streetlights creates an incredible atmosphere. Turn on your motorcycle's headlights and get ready to feel the joy of gliding across the asphalt!

games.title: Fister
games.description: Fist your friends in a chaotic physics-based multiplayer brawler where you fist or be fisted! Wield weapons, powerups, and deadly combos, earn Tokens, unlock swag from the FiStore, and dominate the competition. Includes Fister+ with premium perks, cosmetics, and more.

games.title: Pixel Kitten Desktop
games.description: PIXEL KITTEN DESKTOP is a cozy desktop pet experience where a tiny pixel cat lives right on your screen.Your kitten is always there with you: walking around, dozing off, asking for food, showing little emotes, and reacting to its own needs throughout the day. It is more than a simple animated sticker. Your cat has persistent stats, autonomous behaviors, growth stages, inventory items, and its own little life on your desktop.A tiny cat that feels aliveWatch your kitten roam freely across your desktop, sleep in place, meow for attention, and choose its own actions based on hunger, thirst, energy, cleanliness, mood, health, and affection.Its behavior changes over time, creating the feeling of a small companion quietly living beside you while you work, study, or relax.Raise and care for your kittenTake care of your cat through simple, cozy interactions:Feed it when it gets hungryGive it water when it feels thirstyPlay to improve its moodBrush it to keep it cleanPet it to build affectionLet it rest and recover energyUse medicine when its health is lowAs you spend more time together, your kitten grows from a young cat into a larger adult companion.Collect different pixel catsAdopt your own kitten through a random draw system and discover a wide variety of pixel cat appearances.43 collectible cat variantsDifferent rarity tiersPersistent collection progressMultiple saves for different catsBuild a cozy desktop spaceOpen the in-game manager panel to check on your cat and customize its daily life.Shop for food, bowls, beds, toys, and other itemsPlace furniture on the desktopManage inventory and savesBrowse your cat collectionAdjust settings and language optionsPlaced items are not just decorative. Your kitten can interact with them as part of its daily routine.Designed for a calm, everyday companion vibePIXEL KITTEN DESKTOP is not a high-pressure management game. It is a light, relaxing desktop companion made to bring warmth and personality to your screen.Whether you are working, studying, or just hanging out online, your little pixel kitten is there to keep you company.FeaturesCozy pixel-art desktop petAutonomous cat behavior system7 persistent care stats43 cat variants to discoverGrowth from kitten to adultShop, inventory, and collection systemsFurniture placement on desktopMultiple save slotsChinese and English support

games.title: Guys with Magnets
games.description: Guys with Magnets is a co-op physics parkour game about using a supercharged magnet to move through island courses with up to 8 players. Pull, repel, swing, explode, solve magnetic puzzles, and try to reach the finish together, even when everything goes wrong.

games.title: Lenimals
games.description: Plan the route, place your tools, and let the animals go! Guide rabbits, bears, and monkeys through 150 pixel-art puzzles across forests, caves, and jungles. Use jumps, dashes, and well-timed stops to dodge hazards and collect every sun.

games.title: Hack Faster
games.description: Hack Faster is a story-driven incremental hacking simulator. Scan networks, breach layered defenses, extract valuable files, and erase your traces before lockdown. Push your tools into Overclock, sell what you steal, and upgrade your rig. Aegis pays for results. GHOST wants the truth.

games.title: Last Bottle
games.description: Start with a single boat and a simple hook, then grow an automated ocean-cleanup fleet. Collect trash, upgrade your gear, deploy nets, and reveal a wider sea. Take control or let your crews work until every last bottle is gone.

games.title: Buitopia DVD
games.description: A short interactive DVD game. Today is Jess's Birthday! Can you find her a suitable gift? Just don't get distracted and forget about Jess. DVDs can't be cursed... right? Yeah it's fine.

games.title: Potion Drop
games.description: A satisfying new twist on Match 3 where you search for sets of colorful potions to score points. Match as fast as you can to score high before the board overflows in Arcade mode, or relax and match at your own pace in Zen mode.

games.title: Dreamer's Wake
games.description: A stylized third person collectathon set in collapsing dreamscapes. Play as a Haniwa, a Japanese clay figure, and explore surreal worlds to restore them from static.

games.title: Kill Your Darlings
games.description: The kingdom has imprisoned you in the dungeon! Manage your day-to-day life, date your fellow inmates (who are monsters) and fight by their side to escape in this innovative time-management dating-sim RPG where every choice matters and every playthrough is different.

games.title: Towering Tales
games.description: Explore the tower of Round Cube Manor, collect all the books, and find the right fairytale to lull the Count to sleep.

games.title: Escape: Immersion
games.description: Escape: Immersion is a cinematic 2.5D horror adventure set inside a collapsing underwater military base. Explore flooded corridors, solve environmental puzzles, evade deadly traps, and uncover your past.

games.title: Dark Dice Dungeon
games.description: Three heroes, three dice, a dying lantern. A turn-based dungeon crawler where you don't level up: you reforge the faces of your dice. Two adventures, a Survival mode, a local duel, twenty heroes to recruit. No connection, no ads.

games.title: Imperfect Balance Collection
games.description: Unbalance blocks, make them all fall off the screen! 240 levels! Can you solve all the puzzles? Contains four Imperfect Balance games.

games.title: Wood Watch
games.description: The gates of hell have opened up, and you’re at the front lines. Fend off the demons in a point-and-click horror survival experience. Survive the week to uncover the story and find a way out of your current situation.

games.title: Snemovna
games.description: An absurd survival horror satire set in the Czech Parliament. Sneak through corridors, hide from politicians, and collect real campaign promises in a game full of memes and bizarre buffs.

games.title: Dragon Dinner
games.description: An explosive cocktail of intense strategic action and deceivingly cute dragons! Manage chaotic clients and strategically design your restaurants layouts to handle the rush and serve endless waves of hungry dragons.

games.title: Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi?
games.description: Become part demon and fight in the demons' proxy war, conquering your rivals to help your species claim dominance!

games.title: Kill Your Friends
games.description: A chaotic 2–4 player PvP shooter where the game changes every round. New modes, weapons, and conditions force you to adapt before your friends do.

games.title: Rainbow Islands Console Selection
games.description:
Rainbow Islands is an arcade action game released by Taito in 1987 where the player controls Bubby or Bobby, using their rainbow magic as both weapons and platforms to climb and reach the goal at the highest point of each stage.

Rainbow Island CS is a collection of several home ports of the arcade game Rainbow Islands.

In addition to the popular 8 and 16-bit versions, the collection includes the never-released-on-cartridge MegaDrive/Genesis version. With 24 quick-save/load slots for each version and a feature that displays the location of the diamonds, there's never been a better time to experience it. It also includes a feature that lets you start the game in a powered-up state.

The PC Engine version is based on the NES version and features a main theme arranged for FM sound by Yukiharu Urita, as well as an ending theme composed by Norihiro Furukawa, both Zuntata (Taito's sound team) alumni.

games.title: Cyber Unboxing King
games.description: A cyberpunk unboxing strategy game. Wield unique cybernetic augmentations to outmaneuver rivals, unlock mysterious crates to collect all kinds of cyber collectibles, and build your exclusive holographic museum for a perfect mix of tactical planning and random thrills.

games.title: Mua Hinh (Trading-cards Season)
games.description: Every kid's game has its own season: season of Marbles, season of Rubber bands, season of Statues… and the season of Trading-cards. We bring you those nostalgic games in a fresh “digital” way. Practice, compete online, climb the rankings and elo ladder to earn prestigious titles and unique items!

games.title: Puppetborne
games.description: Journey through a fallen kingdom, conquer dangerous dungeons, and master challenging combat in a dark 2D pixel art action RPG.

games.title: Harold Rabbit 3 : The House of Mysteries
games.description: Harold Rabbit and Maud Bumblebee have been invited to the mansion of Archibald Squirrel, for a great game of wits. Can Harold and Maud solve the riddles and puzzles Archibald Squirrel has prepared for them?

games.title: Starfish ROOM: WELCOME TO LOOP ETERNAL
Blosharper: Battle of Blossoms
games.description: Blosharper is a roguelike deckbuilder that twists the rules of traditional Korean Hwatu. Don't rely on luck—use illicit "cheat" skills to manipulate the deck and survive a deadly underground gambling den. Pay off your crushing debt, defeat ruthless bosses, and become the ultimate sharp!

games.title: DAVE THE DIVER: Complete Edition
games.description:
Complete Edition contains:
- Dave the Diver
- In the Jungle DLC
- Dredge DLC
- Godzilla DLC
- Ichiban's Holiday DLC
- Digital Soundtrack
- Digital Artbook

DAVE THE DIVER is a casual, single player adventure RPG featuring deep-sea exploration and fishing during the day and sushi restaurant management at night. Join Dave and his quirky friends as they seek to uncover the secrets of the mysterious Blue Hole.

games.title: Void Miner
games.description:
Drift into the silence of space, where every run is a mix of calm exploration and split-second decisions. In Void Miner, you’re not just collecting resources - you’re constantly balancing risk and reward as you weave through dense asteroid fields, dodge hazards, and decide how far into the unknown you’re willing to go before turning back.

Each meteorite you break apart tells a small story of progress. Iron (Fe), copper (Cu), and uranium (U) aren’t just resources - they’re your lifeline. Do you play it safe and cash out early, or push deeper for bigger rewards, knowing one mistake could cost everything you’ve gathered?

The ship evolves with you. Every upgrade changes how the game feels - faster movement, tighter control, more efficient mining, or new abilities that open up different playstyles. What starts as a fragile craft slowly becomes a finely tuned machine built for deep-space survival.

games.title: HazardousExtractions
games.description: Extract and survive. Work for a secret organization as you and up to 4 friends become members of an elite squad to retrieve a sample from an underground laboratory full of secrets.

games.title: Sort of Magic
games.description: A cozy organizing game for 1–4 players in online co-op. You're a little magical cat who knocked over an entire magic school. Now put all 4,500 books, potions, and brooms back exactly where they belong. Learn sorting spells, split the rooms with friends, and restore the mess you made.

games.title: Demon General Kirsten
games.description: Kirsten is a soldier troubled by her current way of life. During her adventure, she'll encounter a wide variety of people, and those warm exchanges will shape her in one direction or another...

games.title: Monkey
games.description: Welcome to monkey, play different gamemodes, explore different maps and make sure to have fun!

games.title: Click & Mine
games.description: Click & Mine is a relaxing incremental mining game. Mine various resources and use them to buy upgrades, allowing you to descend deeper and deeper while unlocking new biomes, ores and skills.

games.title: Garden Cleanup Simulator
games.description: Turn overgrown, messy gardens into clean and beautiful spaces. There is no rush. No stress. Just you, your tools, and the simple pleasure of turning chaos into order.

games.title: Once Upon a KATAMARI: Rolling Live Highlights
games.description: Launching alongside the Nintendo Switch 2 version, the Rolling LIVE Highlights DLC brings 10 quests and their iconic soundtracks from the mobile game Katamari Damacy Rolling LIVE, where everything revolves around live streaming. Players will roll alongside Earth's streamers, meet new cousins, and grow their Katamari to help the King stay ahead of the trends, impress his fans, and become even more popular.  The Nintendo Switch 2 version delivers a new rolling sensation with a free update that includes the exclusive mouse controls, alongside a smoother framerate and enhanced graphics. Existing Nintendo Switch players can transfer their save data to Nintendo Switch 2, provided no save data already exists on the system.

games.title: I'm Having A Bad Day
games.description:
Created as a compact and physical VR experience, I’m Having a Bad Day is a cartoon-style game built around a simple idea: breaking things can be fun.

You play as a contestant in a fictional reality show set across different environments. The goal is simple: smash, dismantle, and create as much controlled chaos as possible within a short time limit.

Objects react with exaggerated cartoon physics and clear visual feedback. Power-ups, such as oversized tools or jelly weapons, temporarily shift the pace and encourage different approaches to destruction.

I’m Having a Bad Day is a straightforward, physics-driven VR game built around short bursts of action and repeatable levels, created for players who enjoy quick sessions and physical interaction in virtual space.

games.title: Taerim's Blueberry Defense
games.description: Sweep away the swarming blueberry horde! Taerim's Blueberry Defense is a side-scrolling roguelite defense game bursting with particle effects. Hammer your skills to clear the field, evolve maxed-out skills for a different build every run, and spend Essence to unlock new skills.

games.title: Hood Warfare 2
games.description: Rival gangs fight for control of Chicago. Pick a side, customize your weapons, and fight other players across a variety of action-packed game modes. Spin the block and take over the streets in this chaotic multiplayer FPS.

games.title: Foundation: Harvest Festival
games.description:
Transform your village into a thriving hub of agriculture with the Harvest Festival DLC.

Raise livestock, cultivate new crops, and plant bountiful orchards as you expand your village’s rural economy with new production chains and resources. Then bring it all together by hosting an increasingly prestigious Harvest Festival, culminating in the grandest celebration in the realm.

games.title: Space Breakout Odyssey
games.description: A sci-fi arcade breakout where your colony ship is the paddle. Trapped inside an alien cube, bounce your last projectile through 100 sectors, catch falling capsules to arm lasers, shields and multiball, and break a path back to the stars. Hardcore mode gives you one hull for the entire run.

games.title: Maybe Hero
games.description: Runners dodge gunfire and capture objectives while Snipers defend the tower from above. Master unpredictable Supply powers, switch between distinct roles, and bring your own painted character into a fast 2–12 player asymmetric multiplayer battle.

games.title: Nine Lives Deep
games.description: Enter the deranged world of the madman known only as "Le boucher de salade"!Potato Salad Adventure is a series of four short interactive scenes that attempt to answer age old questions such as: * How much butter should Potato rub on itself?* Does Egg like the taste of egg?* And, is Parsley actually in love with Onion?Don't miss the finale!Trailer: http://youtu.be/sIaW27ci03Y

games.title: Rush Aim Show
games.description: A 3D side-scrolling action game set in a circus. Become a circus performer and put on the ultimate show with explosive clowns!

games.description: The Crown is inspecting the Royal Armory for the first time in 20 years. You have spent 19 of them ignoring the mess. Return thousands of scattered items, each modeled by hand, to their rightful racks in this cozy fantasy organizing game, with your faithful dog Marshmallow by your side.

games.description: Love is Everywhere is a Boys Love visual novel done by Xlyph Bara Games where you will learn how to act in an earthquake emergency and how you could help others.The game is a fictional story taken place in the 2026 Colombia earthquake to raise funds for the emergency.All my condolences to anyone affected by the earthquake, stay safe.This is a story about a guy named Santiago, early morning, he wakes up to an earthquake! and then after it happens he decides to help others becoming a rescue team member,  in this story you'll save Simón a his dog Jovita out of the disaster, let's see how love will make it's way here.I hope this game teach you  how to approach these kind of situations, but please I encourage you to support the official channels of the earthquake emergency relief to help the affected people with the earthquake in Colombia in 2026, remember, TOGETHER WE ARE STRONGER!If you liked this game don't forget to leave a review and support the artistXlyph could keep creating more Bara games, and why not more Boys Love visual novels.Check out my other games!

games.title: Lane Rider: Highway Runner
games.description:
Get behind the wheel of over 20 beautiful cars and explore hundreds of kilometers of highways packed with traffic. Weave between vehicles, discover new destinations, earn money and prove that you have what it takes to climb to the top of the leaderboards.

Lane Rider combines the freedom of an open-world arcade driving game with the speed and intensity of a traffic runner.

games.title: The Dark Sarcophagus
games.description: Jurassic Stones (also known as Connect 4 and Four in a Row) is the classic travel game, where you have align those elusive 4 pieces in a row, either vertically, horizontally or diagonally, and this before your opponent does. This version reflects the original version of the game, when it was played by prehistoric men. A really fun design that will remind you your grand mother.Beware! In trying to create your own line of 4, you may accidentally give one line to your opponent ! This universally popular  game is built with the same high quality as the rest of our games.-  from Beginner to Expert- Highscores- Designed for both Tablet and PhoneThe free version is ad-supported. games.title: Hundred Lives to Immortality
games.description: Begin as a lone cultivator. Train, explore, battle, refine pills and forge artifacts, build your cave dwelling, join a sect, and bond with companions and spirit beasts. Reincarnate across lifetimes, grow stronger, explore eight cities, and fight in the war against demons.

games.title: aSc Boom
games.description:
A gleefully chaotic wizard arena brawler for one to four players. Shove walls into your rivals to crush them, bomb your way out of tight corners, and outrun dragons and rolling crushers across sixteen arenas. 

Play solo against scheming AI, or share one keyboard with friends. Just never kill Janko.

games.title: Boring Ball
games.description: 《Boring Ball》is a physics-based 3D platforming game. Control unique Soul Orbs, navigate challenging geometrical levels, match skills to break platforms, and overcome various obstacles to reach the goal. Experience fun physics-driven gameplay!

games.title: Fragrance - The Second Story of Princess and Knight
games.description: In the year 1511 of the Spear Era, on a moonlit night, a sharp whistle echoes through the Spear Mansion, throwing it into chaos. Amid the confusion, Kasey Spear, the family's second daughter, disappears. And this was the beginning of everything.

games.title: Cursed Images: What You Shouldn't See
games.description:
Could you stay calm when you find what shouldn't be there?

What if an ordinary photo captured something that was never meant to be seen?

Everyday moments can hide an unsettling secret. A casual snapshot may contain a presence, a detail, or a figure that simply does not belong.

Take a close look at each image and search for the one disturbing spot hidden within it.

・Study the photo carefully
・Notice anything that feels out of place
・Click the spot that reveals the answer

The moment you recognize the strange detail, the real shock begins. Can you handle what you find without looking away?

Perfect for fans of paranormal photos, mysteries, urban legends, scary stories, and anyone who enjoys a tense visual puzzle. Play alone for a creepy challenge, or gather friends for a thrilling party session.

If you scare easily, keep the lights on—and take care of any late-night preparations before you play!

games.title: FLOW PIPE CODE ~ Connect the Pipes Logic Puzzle ~
games.description:
Rotate, connect, solve!

Can you restore the flow?

Remember those puzzles that looked simple until every piece mattered? Turn scattered pipe panels and build a complete route in this approachable logic puzzle.

How to play:
・Check the panels with pipes
・Rotate each panel to adjust its direction
・Create a route where the flow connects correctly

Early stages are easy to read, but later layouts add more pipes and increasingly complex routes. Look at the whole board and think through each move: one turn can change everything that follows.

Whether you enjoy pipe puzzles, rotation puzzles, or thoughtful logic games, there is a challenge waiting for you. Test your insight and problem-solving skills, play a few stages during a short break, or take your time with tougher layouts.

Read the tangled routes, complete every connection, and get the flow moving!

games.title: Zodiac 2: Aggres
games.description:
A 1986 classic is reborn. Dive into a gripping sci-fi mystery to find your missing father and the "Blue Crystal" alongside your sharp-tongued partner, Mary.

Released in 1986 by Riverhill Soft, this title is a profound sci-fi mystery that follows a young man—the son of a space archaeologist—and his nagging, antique-loving robot partner, "Amaroid Marie," as they track down the mystery of his missing father.

The story begins five years after the protagonist's father, Dr. Dumas, a leading authority in space archaeology, vanished during a research expedition. Refusing to believe he is gone, the protagonist makes a meager living as a freight hauler while scouring the far reaches of the galaxy for clues alongside Marie.

Though they once survived a life-or-death struggle on a forbidden, dormant planet while chasing the energy of the "Blue Crystal"—a mysterious artifact fragment once embedded in his father’s right arm—the definitive truth remains out of reach, leaving the protagonist in a state of growing frustration.

This stalemate is shattered by a single radio news broadcast. Jason Cannack, a man who served as the doctor’s assistant but fled with stolen research immediately after the disappearance, has been appointed as the new director of the City Library. Sensing a breakthrough, the protagonist’s intuition turns to certainty: "He must know my father's secret."

games.title: Chat Derby Desktop
games.description: Turn your typing into a race! Play solo or race friends in Steam online rooms, type Korean or English text, and collect cosmetic horse skins. Choose quick one-minute rounds or longer sessions in a compact desktop typing game.

games.title: Hello Golf
games.description:
Hello Golf is a minimalist 2D arcade golf game with endlessly generated courses and many game modes. 

Master simple controls, take on thousands of seeded career challenges, play a new course every day, or compete locally with up to 16 players.

games.title: The Return of Illunes
games.description: A hardcore turn-based roguelike where an AI running on YOUR machine writes each run's story, synergies, oaths, and the names and lore of your loot.
